PT Waskita Beton Precast Tbk menjadikan sinergi sebagai dasar utama dalam menjalankan bisnis yang berkelanjutan. Kolaborasi dipahami sebagai cara untuk menggabungkan kekuatan, memaksimalkan sumber daya, dan meningkatkan kinerja Perusahaan secara menyeluruh. Dengan pendekatan ini, WSBP berupaya menjaga pertumbuhan usaha tetap stabil sekaligus mampu menjawab tantangan bisnis yang terus berkembang.

Implementasi sinergi tersebut dijalankan di seluruh proses bisnis, mulai dari kerja sama dengan entitas dalam grup, mitra usaha, pemerintah, hingga masyarakat. Setiap kolaborasi diarahkan untuk meningkatkan efisiensi, mendorong inovasi, serta memperkuat tata kelola perusahaan yang baik. WSBP juga mengintegrasikan prinsip Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) dalam setiap kegiatan usaha, sehingga tidak hanya memberikan hasil secara ekonomi, tetapi juga berdampak positif bagi lingkungan dan sosial.

PT Waskita Beton Precast Tbk places synergy as the primary foundation in conducting sustainable business. Collaboration is understood as a means of combining strengths, maximizing resources, and enhancing overall Company performance. Through this approach, WSBP strives to maintain stable business growth while remaining capable of addressing the continuously evolving challenges of the business landscape.

The implementation of this synergy is carried out across all business processes, ranging from cooperation with entities within the group, business partners, the Government, and the community. Every collaboration is directed toward improving efficiency, driving innovation, and strengthening good corporate governance. WSBP also integrates the principles of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) into every business activity, thereby delivering not only economic results, but also a positive impact on the environment and society.

## DUKUNGAN WSBP TERHADAP PEMBANGUNAN BERKELANJUTAN

Dalam rangka memperkuat kontribusi Perusahaan terhadap mitigasi dampak Lingkungan, Sosial, dan Tata Kelola (Environmental, Social, and Governance/ESG), WSBP secara konsisten mengimplementasikan berbagai program dan kebijakan yang bertujuan untuk memastikan bahwa seluruh aktivitas operasional dilaksanakan secara bertanggung jawab dan berkelanjutan. Komitmen ini diwujudkan melalui penerapan langkah-langkah strategis yang tidak hanya berfokus pada pengelolaan dampak lingkungan, tetapi juga pada peningkatan nilai sosial serta penerapan tata kelola perusahaan yang baik.

Komitmen tersebut juga sejalan dengan berbagai kebijakan dan regulasi pemerintah yang mendorong penerapan praktik pembangunan berkelanjutan di sektor industri dan korporasi. Pemerintah Indonesia telah menetapkan kebijakan terkait pelaksanaan Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (TPB) melalui Peraturan Presiden Nomor 59 Tahun 2017 tentang Pelaksanaan Pencapaian Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan, yang menjadi pedoman bagi pemerintah, dunia usaha, dan masyarakat dalam mendukung agenda pembangunan berkelanjutan di Indonesia. Selain itu, pengelolaan lingkungan hidup di Indonesia juga diatur melalui Undang-Undang Nomor 32 Tahun 2009 tentang Perlindungan dan Pengelolaan Lingkungan Hidup, yang menegaskan kewajiban setiap pelaku usaha untuk menjaga kelestarian lingkungan serta mencegah terjadinya pencemaran dan kerusakan lingkungan. Di sisi lain, penerapan praktik bisnis berkelanjutan juga didorong melalui Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (POJK) No. 51/POJK.03/2017 tentang Penerapan Keuangan Berkelanjutan bagi Lembaga Jasa Keuangan, Emiten, dan Perusahaan Publik, yang mendorong perusahaan untuk mengintegrasikan aspek lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola dalam strategi bisnis serta pelaporan keberlanjutan.

The development of infrastructure projects underway in 2025 will impact the value of new contracts obtained by the Company. In 2025, the Company recorded a New Contract Value (NKB) of Rp1.53 trillion and Revenue of Rp1.57 trillion. WSBP targets NKB growth of 10.16% and an increase in Revenue of up to 16.06% compared to 2024.

## WSBP'S SUPPORT FOR SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT

In order to strengthen the Company's contribution to the mitigation of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) impacts, WSBP consistently implements various programs and policies aimed at ensuring that all operational activities are carried out in a responsible and sustainable manner. This commitment is realized through the implementation of strategic measures that focus not only on managing environmental impacts, but also on enhancing social value and applying good corporate governance practices.

This commitment is also aligned with various government policies and regulations that promote the adoption of sustainable development practices in the industrial and corporate sectors. The Government of Indonesia has established policies pertaining to the implementation of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) through Presidential Regulation No. 59 of 2017 concerning the Implementation of the Achievement of Sustainable Development Goals, which serves as a guideline for the government, the business community, and society in supporting the sustainable development agenda in Indonesia. Furthermore, environmental management in Indonesia is also governed by Law No. 32 of 2009 concerning Environmental Protection and Management, which affirms the obligation of every business entity to preserve the environment and prevent environmental pollution and degradation. Additionally, the adoption of sustainable business practices is further encouraged through the Financial Services Authority Regulation (POJK) No. 51/POJK.03/2017 concerning the Implementation of Sustainable Finance for Financial Services Institutions, Issuers, and Public Companies, which encourages the Company to integrate environmental, social, and governance aspects into their business strategies and sustainability reporting.

Dengan mengacu pada berbagai kebijakan tersebut, WSBP berupaya memastikan bahwa seluruh kegiatan usaha yang dijalankan selaras dengan arah pembangunan nasional yang berkelanjutan. Pada aspek lingkungan, WSBP menjalankan berbagai inisiatif untuk memitigasi dampak yang timbul dari proses operasional. Upaya ini dilakukan antara lain melalui penerapan prinsip Standar Industri Hijau yang berfokus pada efisiensi penggunaan sumber daya, pengurangan emisi, serta optimalisasi proses produksi agar lebih ramah lingkungan. Selain itu, WSBP juga melakukan sertifikasi produk ramah lingkungan guna memastikan bahwa produk yang dihasilkan memenuhi kriteria keberlanjutan, baik dari sisi penggunaan bahan baku, proses produksi, maupun dampaknya terhadap lingkungan sepanjang siklus hidup produk.

Sejalan dengan hal tersebut, WSBP juga menerapkan prosedur pengelolaan lingkungan secara sistematis yang mengacu pada standar serta peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Implementasi ini mencakup pengelolaan limbah menggunakan Instalasi Pengelolaan Air Limbah (IPAL), pengendalian emisi, pemantauan kualitas lingkungan, serta penerapan praktik operasional yang berorientasi pada pencegahan pencemaran. Seluruh upaya tersebut dilakukan secara berkelanjutan melalui proses pemantauan, evaluasi, dan peningkatan kinerja lingkungan guna memastikan bahwa kegiatan operasional perusahaan tetap selaras dengan prinsip perlindungan lingkungan dan pembangunan berkelanjutan.

Sebagai bagian dari komitmen terhadap keberlanjutan, WSBP juga mengimplementasikan berbagai program Tanggung Jawab Sosial dan Lingkungan (TJSL) yang bertujuan untuk memberikan manfaat nyata bagi masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasional Perusahaan. Seluruh kegiatan tersebut dijalankan melalui program tanggung jawab sosial perusahaan WSBP Inspiring Kindness, yang menjadi payung bagi berbagai inisiatif sosial dan lingkungan WSBP.

Pada aspek lingkungan, WSBP menjalankan program WSBP Inspiring Kindness: Piles of Sustainability, di mana setiap penjualan 10 (sepuluh) batang Spun Pile akan diikuti dengan penanaman 1 (satu) pohon sebagai upaya mendukung pelestarian lingkungan serta meningkatkan tutupan hijau di berbagai wilayah. On the environmental front, WSBP carries out various initiatives to mitigate the impacts arising from its operational processes. These efforts include, among others, the application of Green Industry standards focusing on resource use efficiency, emission reduction, and the optimization of production processes to be more environmentally friendly. In addition, WSBP also undertakes green product certification to ensure that its products meet sustainability criteria, both in terms of raw material usage, production processes, and their environmental impact throughout the product life cycle.

In line with the foregoing, WSBP also implements systematic environmental management procedures in accordance with applicable standards and regulations. This implementation encompasses waste management using a Wastewater Treatment Plant (IPAL), emission control, environmental quality monitoring, and the application of pollution prevention-oriented operational practices. All of these efforts are carried out on an ongoing basis through processes of monitoring, evaluation, and improvement of environmental performance, to ensure that the Company's operational activities remain aligned with the principles of environmental protection and sustainable development.

As part of its commitment to sustainability, WSBP also implements various Corporate Social and Environmental Responsibility (CSR) programs aimed at delivering tangible benefits to communities in the vicinity of the Company's operational areas. All such activities are carried out under the WSBP Inspiring Kindness corporate social responsibility program, which oversees WSBP's various social and environmental initiatives.

On the environmental aspect, WSBP conducts the WSBP Inspiring Kindness: Piles of Sustainability program, whereby every sale of 10 (ten) Spun Pile units is followed by the planting of 1 (one) tree as an effort to support environmental conservation and increase green coverage across various regions. ## Kebijakan Untuk Merespons Tantangan Dalam Pemenuhan Strategi Keberlanjutan

Isu perubahan iklim dan pemanasan global merupakan permasalahan global yang memerlukan penanganan secara serius dan kolaboratif. Apabila tidak diantisipasi secara tepat, dampak yang ditimbulkan berpotensi mengancam keberlangsungan ekosistem serta kehidupan makhluk hidup di masa depan. Oleh karena itu, diperlukan sinergi antara pemerintah, sektor industri, komunitas ilmiah, serta masyarakat luas untuk mengurangi emisi gas rumah kaca, melindungi ekosistem, serta mendorong terciptanya pembangunan yang lebih berkelanjutan. Sebagai perusahaan BUMN yang bergerak di bidang manufaktur Beton Precast, Beton Readymix, dan Jasa Konstruksi, WSBP memahami peran strategisnya dalam mendukung upaya pengendalian perubahan iklim serta pengelolaan dampak lingkungan yang timbul dari aktivitas operasional perusahaan.

Dalam merespons tantangan tersebut, WSBP menerapkan kebijakan yang berfokus pada optimalisasi proses produksi dengan pendekatan yang lebih efisien, inovatif, dan berkelanjutan. Komitmen ini diwujudkan melalui berbagai inisiatif yang mendukung penerapan prinsip industri hijau serta pengembangan produk ramah lingkungan sebagai bagian dari strategi keberlanjutan Perusahaan. Penerapan prinsip tersebut bertujuan untuk meningkatkan efisiensi penggunaan energi dan sumber daya, mengurangi potensi emisi serta limbah dari proses produksi, serta memastikan bahwa aktivitas operasional Perusahaan dilaksanakan dengan memperhatikan aspek perlindungan lingkungan.

These various measures, the Company endeavors to ensure that all business activities are conducted in a transparent, accountable, and responsible manner, in order to maintain long-term business sustainability and deliver added value to all stakeholders.

Through these various initiatives, WSBP strives to make a tangible contribution to mitigating environmental impacts while simultaneously supporting the creation of positive social value and the application of good corporate governance, allowing the Company's existence and activities to deliver sustainable benefits to its stakeholders and society at large.

## WSBP's Policy to Address Challenges in Achieving Sustainableity Strategy

The issues of climate change and global warming are global issues that require serious and collaborative action. If not properly anticipated, the impacts they generate have the potential to threaten the sustainability of ecosystems and the lives of living beings in the future. Therefore, synergy is required among the government, the industrial sector, the scientific community, and society at large to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, protect ecosystems, and promote the creation of more sustainable development. As a state-owned enterprise (SOE) operating in the sectors of Precast Concrete, and Readymix Concrete manufacture and Construction Services, WSBP recognizes its strategic role in supporting efforts to address climate change and manage the environmental impacts arising from the Company's operational activities.

In responding to these challenges, WSBP implements policies focused on optimizing production processes through a more efficient, innovative, and sustainable approach. This commitment is realized through various initiatives supporting the application of green industry principles and the development of green products as part of the Company's sustainability strategy. The application of these principles aims to improve energy and resource use efficiency, reduce potential emissions and waste from production processes, and ensure that the Company's operational activities are carried out with due regard for environmental protection.

## Kinerja Aspek Ekonomi

Sepanjang tahun 2025, WSBP mencatatkan Pendapatan Usaha sebesar Rp1.569,57 miliar atau 89,76% dari target. Perusahaan juga membukukan Laba Kotor sebesar Rp274,47 miliar atau 80,39% dari target. Sementara itu, Rugi Sebelum Pajak tercatat sebesar (Rp537,37) miliar atau 124,45% dari target, dengan Rugi Bersih Tahun Berjalan sebesar (Rp537,37) miliar atau 124,45% dari target. Penurunan pada Laba Bersih Perusahaan dipengaruhi oleh menurunnya Pendapatan Usaha dan Laba Kotor yang didorong oleh beberapa faktor, antara lain adanya perubahan fokus program pemerintah dari sektor infrastruktur serta penyesuaian harga produk Beton Precast yang mengikuti dinamika kondisi industri.

Dari sisi perolehan kontrak, WSBP mencatatkan Nilai Kontrak Baru (NKB) sebesar Rp1.528,15 miliar atau 68,94% dari target Revisi RKAP 2025. Selain itu, WSBP juga mencatatkan Sisa Nilai Kontrak (SNK) sebesar Rp1.285,43 miliar atau 100% dari target, serta Nilai Kontrak Dikelola (NKD) sebesar Rp2.813,58 miliar atau 80,43% dari target. Dinamika perolehan kontrak baru pada tahun 2025 dipengaruhi oleh beberapa faktor, di antaranya kebijakan efisiensi anggaran pemerintah yang berdampak pada penyesuaian jadwal maupun skala sejumlah proyek infrastruktur. Selain itu, terdapat beberapa proyek yang mengalami penyesuaian waktu pelaksanaan sehingga proses kontraktualnya bergeser dari rencana awal. Di sisi lain, tingkat persaingan harga yang semakin kompetitif di industri konstruksi turut memengaruhi perolehan kontrak pada sejumlah proyek. Secara umum, kondisi ini juga sejalan dengan penyesuaian fokus program pemerintah terhadap sektor prioritas lainnya yang turut memengaruhi dinamika peluang proyek infrastruktur pada tahun berjalan.

Through these policies, WSBP strives to maintain a balance between achieving operational performance and fulfilling environmental responsibilities, while simultaneously strengthening the Company's competitiveness amid growing market demands for sustainable business practices.

## Economic Aspect Performance

Throughout 2025, WSBP recorded Revenues of Rp1,569.57 billion, representing 89.76% of the target. The Company also posted Gross Profit of Rp274.47 billion, or 80.39% of the target. Furthermore, Loss Before Tax was recorded at (Rp537.37) billion, or 124.45% of the target, with Net Loss for the Year at (Rp537.37) billion, or 124.45% of the target. The decline in the Company's Net Profit was attributed to a decrease in Revenues and Gross Profit, driven by several factors, including a shift in the Government's program focus away from the infrastructure sector and adjustments to Precast Concrete product prices in response to the dynamics of industry conditions.

In terms of contract acquisition, WSBP recorded a New Contract Value (NKB) of Rp1,528.15 billion, or 68.94% of the 2025 Revised Work Plan and Budget (RKAP) target. In addition, WSBP also recorded a Remaining Contract Value (SNK) of Rp1,285.43 billion, or 100% of the target, and a Managed Contract Value (NKD) of Rp2,813.58 billion, or 80.43% of the target. The dynamics of new contract acquisition in 2025 were influenced by several factors, including the Government's budget efficiency policy, which had an impact on the adjustment of schedules and the scale of a number of infrastructure projects. Furthermore, the timelines of several projects were adjusted, causing their contractual processes to shift from the initial plan. Moreover, the increasingly competitive price competition in the construction industry also affected contract acquisition on a number of projects. In general, these conditions are also consistent with the Government's adjustment of its program focus toward other priority sectors, which further influenced the dynamics of infrastructure project opportunities during the year.

Perusahaan mengintegrasikan aspek keberlanjutan ke dalam perencanaan, penganggaran, dan pelaksanaan operasional, sehingga target lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola menjadi bagian dari pengelolaan kinerja.

2. Efisiensi Proses Produksi Berbasis Lean dan Pengendalian Pemborosan (Waste)

Perusahaan mengoptimalkan proses produksi untuk meningkatkan produktivitas dan efisiensi biaya sekaligus menurunkan pemborosan material, energi, dan waktu proses. # TARGET ACHIEVEMENT STRATEGY

To achieve its sustainability performance targets, WSBP implements a strategy that is integrated with the Company's business plan and the execution of the Business Resilience & Growth Program. This strategy is carried out through the strengthening of governance, operational effectiveness, product innovation, and the measurable management of environmental impacts across all lines of operation. WSBP's sustainability target achievement strategy is implemented through the following key steps:

1. Integration of Sustainability into Business Processes and Decision-Making

The Company integrates sustainability aspects into planning, budgeting, and operational execution, ensuring that environmental, social, and governance targets become an integral part of performance management.

2. Lean-Based Production Process Efficiency and Waste Control

The Company optimizes its production processes to improve productivity and cost efficiency while simultaneously reducing material, energy, and process time waste. This approach supports quality consistency, order fulfillment timeliness, and the reduction of environmental impacts from production activities.

# PROSPEK DAN PELUANG

Pertumbuhan ekonomi dunia 2026 diperkirakan sedikit lebih rendah menjadi sebesar 3,2% dibandingkan dengan tahun 2025 yang sebesar 3,3%. Pertumbuhan yang lebih rendah tersebut terutama dipengaruhi oleh dampak lanjutan tarif resiprokal Amerika Serikat (AS) dan kerentanan rantai pasok global, meskipun prospek perekonomian Amerika Serikat membaik didorong investasi sektor teknologi termasuk Artificial Intelligence (AI) dan stimulus fiskal pengurangan pajak. Sementara itu, pertumbuhan ekonomi Jepang, Tiongkok, dan India pada 2026 diproyeksikan melambat akibat pelemahan permintaan domestik dan ekspor di tengah investasi AI yang juga meningkat.

Di tengah tantangan situasi ekonomi dunia, pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional pada tahun 2026 diproyeksikan akan tetap menguat, tumbuh mencapai target 5,4%. Pemerintah optimis dengan target pertumbuhan tersebut. Berbagai capaian penting dalam agenda perdagangan internasional akan mendukung prospek ekonomi Indonesia ke depan.

Pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional yang diprediksi menguat pada 2026, ditopang oleh lonjakan kinerja sektor jasa dan infrastruktur. Sisi lapangan usaha, sektor transportasi dan pergudangan diproyeksikan tumbuh paling tinggi, yakni pada kisaran 10,8%-11,6% secara tahunan (year on year/YoY). Sementara sektor konstruksi diperkirakan melesat di kisaran 7,5%-8,3% pada 2026, jauh lebih tinggi dibandingkan estimasi 2025 yang sebesar 4,7%-5,5%. Di sisi lain, sektor manufaktur ditargetkan dapat memberikan kontribusi sebesar 18,56% terhadap produk domestik bruto (PDB) nasional pada tahun 2026, dengan pertumbuhan di angka 5,51%.

Didasari atas asumsi proyeksi tersebut, Perusahaan optimis kinerja operasional di tahun 2026 akan tumbuh positif. Perusahaan telah menetapkan arah strategis jangka panjang 2026-2030 dengan fokus utama pada penyelesaian restrukturisasi, peningkatan profitabilitas operasional, dan penguatan fundamental keuangan. Langkah ini menjadi bagian dari upaya perusahaan untuk memperbaiki kinerja dan memastikan keberlanjutan bisnis di tengah tantangan industri konstruksi.

# PROSPECTS AND OPPORTUNITIES

Global economic growth in 2026 is projected to be slightly lower at 3.2% compared to 3.3% in 2025, primarily influenced by the continued impact of reciprocal tariffs in the United States and vulnerabilities in the global supply chain, although the US economic outlook is improving, driven by investment in the technology sector, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), and fiscal stimulus through tax cuts. Meanwhile, economic growth in Japan, China, and India is projected to slow in 2026 due to weakening domestic demand and exports amidst increasing investment in AI.

National economic growth in 2026 is projected to remain strong in the challenging global economic situation, reaching the 5.4% target. The government is optimistic about this growth target. Various important achievements in the international trade agenda will support Indonesia's future economic prospects.

National economic growth is predicted to strengthen in 2026, supported by a surge in the services and infrastructure sectors. Among business sectors, the transportation and warehousing sector is projected to grow the highest, at around 10.8%-11.6% year-on-year (YoY). Meanwhile, the construction sector is projected to accelerate to 7.5%-8.3% in 2026, significantly higher than the 2025 estimate of 4.7%-5.5%. Meanwhile, the manufacturing sector is targeted to contribute 18.56% to the national gross domestic product (GDP) in 2026, with growth at 5.51%.

Based on these projected assumptions, the Company is optimistic that operational performance in 2026 will grow positively. The Company has established a long-term strategic direction for 2026-2030, with a primary focus on completing restructuring, increasing operational profitability, and strengthening financial fundamentals. This step is part of the Company's efforts to improve performance and ensure business sustainability amidst the challenges of the construction industry.

## PRINSIP PELAPORAN

Penyusunan Laporan Keberlanjutan ini mengacu pada 8 (delapan) prinsip pelaporan sebagaimana ditentukan dalam GRI 1: Landasan 2021 sebagai berikut:

1. Akurasi

2. Keseimbangan
Perusahaan melaporkan informasi dengan cara netral dan menyediakan gambaran yang seimbang tentang dampak negatif dan positif organisasi.

3. Kejelasan
Perusahaan menyajikan informasi dengan cara yang dapat diakses dan dapat dipahami.

4. Keterbandingan
Perusahaan memilih, menyusun, dan melaporkan informasi secara konsisten agar mereka dapat melakukan analisis mengenai perubahan dalam dampak organisasi seiring waktu dan analisis dampak ini yang berkaitan dengan dampak organisasi lain.

5. Kelengkapan
Perusahaan menyediakan informasi yang memadai agar penilaian dampak organisasi dapat dilakukan selama periode pelaporan.

6. Konteks Keberlanjutan
Perusahaan melaporkan informasi tentang dampak mereka dalam konteks yang lebih luas dari pembangunan berkelanjutan.

7. Ketepatan Waktu
Perusahaan melaporkan informasi secara rutin dan menyediakan informasi tersebut secara tepat waktu bagi pengguna informasi untuk mengambil keputusan.

8. Keterverifikasian

## REPORTING PRINCIPLES

The Sustainability Report is prepared by referring to 8 (eight) reporting principles as specified in GRI 1: Foundation 2021, as follows:

1. Accuracy
The Company reports correct and detailed information to allow an organizational impact assessment to be carried out.

2. Balance
The Company reports information in a neutral manner and provides a balanced overview of the negative and positive impacts of the organization.

3. Clarity
The Company presents information in an accessible and understandable manner.

4. Comparability
The Company selects, compiles, and reports information consistently so that an analysis of changes in the organization's impacts over time and an analysis of these impacts in relation to the impacts of other organizations can be made.

5. Completeness
The Company provides sufficient information so that an organizational impact assessment can be carried out during the reporting period.

6. Context of Sustainability
The Company reports information about its impacts in the broader context of sustainable development.

7. Timeliness
The Company reports information regularly and provides information in a timely manner for information users to make decisions.

8. Verifiability
The Company collects, records, compiles, and analyzes information in such a way that the information can be examined to determine its quality.

Sekilas Perusahaan

The Company at a Glance

Sepanjang tahun 2025, WSBP berhasilmeningkatkan kapasitasproduksi yang mampu memenuhi kebutuhan Beton Precast dan Beton Readymix baik untuk internal maupun eksternal Waskita. Peningkatan ini turut mendorong pertumbuhan kinerja ekonomi Perusahaan secara signifikan.

Throughout 2025, WSBP successfully increased its production capacity to meet the demand for Precast Concrete and Readymix Concrete, both for internal and external Waskita needs. This increase has also significantly driven the growth of the Company's economic performance.

![img-20.jpeg](img-20.jpeg)

Sejalan dengan pembangunan infrastruktur di Indonesia yang semakin pesat, make kebutuhan pasar Beton Precast dan Beton Readymix pun turut meningkat. Tren tersebut membuat PT Waskita Karya (Persero) Tbk (WASKITA) mengambil kebijakan untuk melakukan spin off terhadap Divisi Precast sehingga menjadi entitas bisnis yang mandiri.

Rencana spin off akhirnya diwujudkan pada 7 Oktober 2014, sekaligus menandai lahirnya PT Waskita Beton Precast Tbk. Pendiriannya Perusahaan dicatat dalam Akta Pendirian No. 10, yang dibuat di hadapan notaris Fathiah Helmi, S.H., di Jakarta, dan telah memperoleh persetujuan dari Menteri Hukum dan Hak Asasi Manusia dengan Surat Keputusan No. AHU-29347.40.10.2014 tanggal 14 Oktober 2014. Kebijakan spin off dilakukan WASKITA untuk mengakselerasi pengembangan usaha segmen Beton Precast dan Beton Readymix yang potensi dan ceruk pasarnya masih sangat menjanjikan.

In line with the rapid increase of infrastructure development in Indonesia, the market demand for Precast Concrete and Readymix Concrete is also increasing. This trend has made PT Waskita Karya (Persero) Tbk (WASKITA) take a policy to spin off the Precast Division to become an independent business entity.

The spin-off plan was officially carried out on October 7, 2014, as well as marking the establishment of PT Waskita Beton Precast Tbk. The legality of its establishment was stated in Deed of Establishment No. 10, before a notary, Fathiah Helmi, S.H., in Jakarta, and approved by the Minister of Law and Human Rights via Decree No. AHU-29347.40.10.2014 dated October 14, 2014. WASKITA conducted the spin-off to accelerate business development of the Precast Concrete and Readymix Concrete segment, whose potential and market niches are still very promising.

5. Memberikan dampak yang positif terhadap nilai Pemegang Saham maupun dalam bentuk dividen, baik bagi anak usaha maupun induk.

Setelah resmi menjadi entitas tersendiri, Insan WSBP bersinergi untuk mewujudkan kinerja terbaik. Upaya kolektif tersebut berhasil sehingga dari tahun ke tahun, kinerja WSBP terus meningkat. Sebagai pembanding, pada tahun 2013, saat Divisi Precast WASKITA pertama kali beroperasi, produksi Beton Precast tercatat sebesar 616 ribu ton per tahun. Setelah menjadi entitas anak usaha yang mandiri pada tahun 2014, produksi Beton Precast meningkat menjadi 800 ribu ton per tahun. Bahkan, pada tahun 2015, kuantitas produksi Beton Precast melonjak hingga mencapai 1,8 juta ton per tahun.

Keberhasilan Perusahaan meningkatkan kapasitas produksi tak hanya mampu memenuhi kebutuhan beton precast untuk WASKITA sebagaimana tujuan awal perusahaan didirikan, namun juga membuat WSBP bisa memenuhi kebutuhan eksternal di luar WASKITA. Perkembangan tersebut otomatis membuat kinerja ekonomi Perusahaan semakin membaik, pendapatan dan laba bersih pun terus meningkat.

Raihan kinerja yang terus membaik mendorong Perusahaan untuk membesarkan skala usahanya, apalagi potensi dan pemanfaatan Beton Precast dan Beton Readymix di Indonesia masih sangat besar. Aksi korporasi melalui Penawaran Umum Pemegang Saham atau Initial Public Offering (IPO) pun dipilih. Pada 20 September 2016, IPO digelar di mana WSBP melepas sebanyak-banyaknya 10,54 miliar lembar saham baru dengan harga penawaran Rp490 per lembar saham. Pada pembukaan perdagangan perdana, saham WSBP melonjak Rp50 atau 9,26% dari harga awal Rp490,- menjadi Rp540,-. Dari hasil IPO tersebut, WSBP meraih dana segar sebesar Rp5,2 triliun.

Perusahaan melakukan IPO tak hanya untuk menguatkan modal kerja, namun juga bertujuan untuk membangun pengelolaan usaha yang lebih prudent. Lebih dari itu, dengan perubahan status menjadi perusahaan terbuka, WSBP optimis dapat bertransformasi menjadi perusahaan publik yang besar dan terpercaya di sektor manufaktur Beton Precast dan Beton Readymix.

5. Provide a positive impact on shareholder value as well as in the form of dividends, both for subsidiaries and parents.

After officially becoming a separate entity, WSBP's people are synergizing to generate their best performance. Such collective efforts have produced positive results, and from year to year, the performance of WSBP is growing. As an illustration, in 2013, when WASKITA Precast Division first started to operate, the production of Precast Concrete was recorded at 616 thousand tons per year. After becoming an independent subsidiary in 2014, the Precast Concrete production increased to 800 thousand tons per year. In 2015, the quantity of Precast Concrete production soared to reach 1.8 million tons per year.

The Company's success in increasing production capacity not only meets the need for precast concrete for WASKITA, as the initial goal of the Company's establishment, but also enables WSBP to meet external demands beyond WASKITA. This development automatically improves the economic performance of the Company, leading to continuous growth in revenue and net profit.

The continuous performance improvement has encouraged the Company to expand its business scale, especially considering the vast potential and utilization of Precast Concrete and Readymix Concrete in Indonesia. A corporate action through an Initial Public Offering (IPO) was chosen. On September 20, 2016, an IPO was held where the Company issued a maximum of 10.54 billion new shares at an offering price of Rp490 per share. On the first day of trading, the Company's shares surged by Rp50 or 9.26% from the initial price of Rp490 to Rp540. From the proceeds of the IPO, WSBP raised fresh funds amounting to Rp5.2 trillion.

The Company's IPO was conducted not only to strengthen working capital, but it also aims to build more prudent business management. Moreover, with the change in status to a public company, WSBP is optimistic about its ability to transform into a large and trusted public company in the Precast Concrete & Readymix Concrete manufacturing sector.

“Dedication for Movement” sebagai dasar budaya etika perusahaan menjadi identitas, di mana WSBP terus bergerak untuk kemajuan infrastruktur. WSBP percaya dengan lini usaha di bidang manufaktur Beton Precast, Beton Readymix, Quarry, Jasa Konstruksi, dan Post-Tension, serta dengan berbagai inovasi produk yang diciptakan, WSBP dapat terus berkontribusi nyata untuk Indonesia.

Melalui “Dedication for Movement”, WSBP berharap dapat meningkatkan brand image, added value, dan menghasilkan trademark bagi perusahaan. Identitas ini menjadi aset yang penting dan menjadi cerminan karakter WSBP. Bukan hanya identitas merek, tetapi mewakili nilai-nilai inti, visi, dan misi WSBP.

Sedangkan informasi mengenai identitas WSBP ditetapkan dalam Surat Keputusan Direksi PT Waskita Beton Precast Tbk No. 153/SK/WBP/PEN/2024 tanggal 15 Agustus 2024, tentang Panduan Dasar Jenama Brand Guideline dan Penggunaan Logo ISO 37001, ISO 45001, ISO 12001, ISO 9001, ISO 27001 PT Waskita Beton Precast Tbk.

“Dedication for Movement” as the basis of the Company’s ethical culture becomes an identity, where WSBP continues to move for infrastructure progress. WSBP believes that with its lines of business in the fields of Precast Concrete manufacturing, Readymix Concrete, Quarry, Construction Services, and Post-Tension, as well as with various product innovations created, WSBP can continue to make a real contribution to Indonesia.

Through “Dedication for Movement”, WSBP hopes to enhance brand image, added value, and generate a trademark for the Company. This identity is an important asset and a reflection of the Company’s character. Not only as a brand identity, but represents WSBP’s core values, vision, and mission.

The Basis for Corporate Ethics Culture is based on the Decree of the Board of Directors of PT Waskita Beton Precast Tbk No. 152/SK/WBP/PEN/2024 dated August 24, 2024, concerning the Code of Conduct. Sustainable Corporate Governance

WSBP terus melakukan innovasi, mengembangkan produk-produk baru agar bisa bersaing dan mempertahankan posisinya. Untuk keperluan pengembangan produk, WSBP menganggarkan biaya guna penelitian dan pengembangan produk sebesar Rp757.650.151, mengalami penurunan dibandingkan dengan tahun 2024 yang sebesar Rp1.026.283.045. Penurunan ini terjadi karena beberapa produk telah menyelesaikan tahapan uji mutu dan memperoleh sertifikasi, sehingga kebutuhan pengujian lanjutan menjadi lebih terbatas. Selain itu, Perusahaan juga mengoptimalkan kerja sama dengan pihak ketiga dalam kegiatan penelitian dan pengembangan, yang berkontribusi pada efisiensi biaya.

WSBP continuously innovates and develops new products to compete and maintain its position. For this purpose, WSBP has budgeted funds for conducting research and product development of Rp757,650,151, which was a decrease compared to 2024 which amounted to Rp1,026,283,045. This decrease occurred because several products have completed the quality testing phase and obtained certification, thereby reducing the need for further testing. In addition, the Company has optimized its collaboration with third parties in research and development activities, which has contributed to cost efficiency.

# Rantai Pasok [GRI 2-6]

Supply Chain [GRI 2-6]

WSBP membutuhkan dukungan para pemasok untuk memenuhi kebutuhan baku operasional. Untuk itu, Perusahaan mengelola rantai pasok serta pengadaan barang dan jasa sesuai dengan regulasi/ketentuan dari Kementerian Badan Usaha Milik Negara di antaranya Peraturan Menteri Badan Usaha Milik Negara Republik Indonesia No. PER-2/MBU/03/2023 tentang Pedoman Tata Kelola dan Kegiatan Korporasi Signifikan Badan Usaha Milik Negara.

Pada proses pengadaan barang dan jasa, Perusahaan menerapkan prinsip transparan, adil dan akuntabel. Hal ini untuk mencegah Korupsi, Kolusi, dan Nepotisme (KKN), meningkatkan kepercayaan publik, serta memastikan efisiensi dan mendapatkan bahan baku berkualitas terbaik dengan harga kompetitif (value for money).

Dalam rangka mendukung kebijakan pemerintah terkait Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri (TKDN), Perusahaan memberdayakan pemasok nasional/lokal dengan tujuan agar pemasok nasional/lokal dapat semakin maju dan berkembang, yang pada akhirnya meningkatkan perekonomian mereka. Pemasok nasional/lokal, merupakan pemasok yang berdomisili dan menjalankan usahanya di Indonesia, pada tahun pelaporan tercatat sebanyak 448 atau 100% dari total pemasok.

Selain pemasok nasional/lokal, Perusahaan juga membuka peluang untuk menjalin kerja sama dengan pemasok luar negeri. Kerja sama ini dilakukan apabila barang dan jasa yang diperlukan Perusahaan tidak dapat dipenuhi oleh pemasok nasional/lokal atau karena ada alasan/pertimbangan khusus. Berikut jumlah pemasok barang dan jasa yang bermitra dengan Perusahaan sepanjang 3 (tiga) tahun terakhir:

WSBP requires the support of suppliers to meet operational raw material needs. Therefore, the Company manages the supply chain as well as the procurement of goods and services in line with the Ministry of State-Owned Enterprises (BUMN), including Regulation of the Minister of State-Owned Enterprises of the Republic of Indonesia No. PER-2/MBU/03/2023 concerning Guidelines for Governance and Significant Corporate Activities of State-Owned Enterprises.

In the procurement process of goods and services, the Company applies the principles of transparency, fairness, and accountability to prevent Corruption, Collusion, and Nepotism (KKN), increase public trust, and ensure efficiency and obtain the best quality raw materials at competitive prices (value for money).

In support of government policies regarding the Local Content Level (TKDN), the Company empowers national/local suppliers with the aim of helping them grow and develop, thereby ultimately boosting their economies. National/local suppliers are those domiciled and operating in Indonesia; as of the reporting year, there were 448 such suppliers, representing 100% of the total supplier base.

In addition to national/local suppliers, the Company also opens opportunities to establish partnerships with foreign suppliers. This collaboration is undertaken when the goods and services required by the Company cannot be met by national/local suppliers or due to specific reasons or considerations. Tata Kelola Perusahaan Berkelanjutan

Sustainable Corporate Governance

Perusahaan secara berkala melakukan pembaruan Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku (Code of Conduct) sebagai landasan bagi seluruh Insan WSBP dalam menjalankan kegiatan usaha yang berintegritas serta selaras dengan prinsip prinsip GCG. The Company periodically updates its Code of Conduct as the foundation for all Insan WSBP in conducting business activities with integrity and in alignment with the principles of GCG.

![img-35.jpeg](img-35.jpeg)

# KOMITMEN PENERAPAN GCG

Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik atau Good Corporate Governance (GCG) menjadi fondasi strategis bagi perusahaan dalam menciptakan bisnis yang sehat dan berkelanjutan. Berangkat dari pemahaman tersebut, WSBP secara konsisten mengimplementasikan prinsip-prinsip GCG dalam operasional bisnisnya. Dengan menerapkan prinsip-prinsip GCG, Perusahaan dapat menjalankan bisnisnya secara transparan, akuntabel dan beretika. Penerapan GCG memungkinkan Perusahaan menjalankan operasinya selaras dengan harapan publik, membangun kepercayaan dengan pemangku kepentingan, meningkatkan kinerja keuangan dan efisiensi operasional, serta meminimalkan risiko, yang pada akhirnya mendukung keberlanjutan bisnis jangka panjang.

# COMMITMENT TO GCG IMPLEMENTATION

Good Corporate Governance (GCG) is a strategic foundation for the Company in creating a healthy and sustainable business. Based on this understanding, WSBP consistently implements GCG principles in its business operations. By implementing GCG principles, the Company can conduct its business transparently, accountably, and ethically. The implementation of GCG enables the Company to conduct its operations in line with public expectations, build trust with stakeholders, improve financial performance and operational efficiency, and minimize risks, ultimately supporting long-term business sustainability.

Suksesion Corporate Governance

Badan Usaha Milik Negara, serta Pedoman Umum GCG di Indonesia yang dikeluarkan oleh Komite Nasional Kebijakan Governance (KNKG), yaitu Pedoman Umum Governansi Korporat Indonesia (PUGKI), serta pedoman dan praktik yang dijalankan di lingkungan Perusahaan, yakni Pedoman Tata Kelola Perusahaan WSBP.

Corporate Activities of State-Owned Enterprises, as well as the General Guidelines for GCG in Indonesia issued by the National Committee for Governance Policy (KNKG), namely the General Guidelines for Indonesian Corporate Governance (PUGKI), and the guidelines and practices implemented within the Company, namely the WSBP Corporate Governance Guidelines.

WSBP memandang implementasi Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik bukan sekadar fondasi Perusahaan, tetapi juga memiliki tujuan strategis bagi Perusahaan, antara lain:

1. Melindungi hak dan kepentingan Pemegang Saham dan Pemangku Kepentingan;
2. Mendorong Pemegang Saham, Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, dan Insan WSBP untuk mengambil keputusan dan menjalankan tindakannya dilandasi oleh nilai moral yang tinggi dan keputusan terhadap peraturan perundang-undangan; dan
3. Meningkatkan nilai Perusahaan.

WSBP views the implementation of Good Corporate Governance as not only the foundation of the Company, but also has strategic objectives for the Company, including:

1. Protecting the rights and interests of Shareholders and Stakeholders;
2. Encouraging Shareholders, the Board of Commissioners, the Board of Directors, and Insan WSBP to make decisions and carry out their actions based on high moral values and decisions in accordance with laws and regulations; and
3. Increasing the Company's value.

# PRINSIP-PRINSIP GCG

Komitmen WSBP dalam menerapkan GCG secara menyeluruh dalam lini bisnis Perusahaan, membawa WSBP memiliki kemampuan daya saing dan menghasilkan pertumbuhan positif. Penerapan prinsip-prinsip GCG, yaitu transparansi, akuntabilitas, responsibilitas, independensi, serta fairness yang dijalankan oleh Perusahaan telah sesuai dengan Peraturan Menteri Badan Usaha Milik Negara Republik Indonesia No. PER-2/MBU/03/2023 tentang Pedoman Tata Kelola dan Kegiatan Korporasi Signifikan Badan Usaha Milik Negara. Pada praktiknya, kelima prinsip tersebut disesuaikan dengan karakter khas dan nilai-nilai yang dimiliki WSBP.

# GCG PRINCIPLES

WSBP's commitment to implementing GCG comprehensively across the Company's business lines has enabled WSBP to achieve competitiveness and generate positive growth. The Company's implementation of GCG principles, namely transparency, accountability, responsibility, independence, and fairness, is in accordance with Regulation of the Minister of State-Owned Enterprises of the Republic of Indonesia No. PER-2/MBU/03/2023 concerning Guidelines for Governance and Significant Corporate Activities of State-Owned Enterprises. In practice, these five principles are adapted to the unique character and values of WSBP.

# STRUKTUR TATA KELOLA [GRI 2-9, 2-11]

Berdasarkan Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia No. 40 tahun 2007 tentang Perseroan Terbatas (UU PT), struktur tata kelola Perusahaan meliputi Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham (RUPS), Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi. Untuk system kepengurusan tata kelola, sesuai dengan Anggaran Dasar Perusahaan, WSBP menganut system dua badan (two tier system), yaitu Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi yang memiliki wewenang dan tanggung jawab yang jelas sesuai fungsinya masing-masing sebagaimana diamanatkan dalam Anggaran Dasar Perusahaan dan peraturan perundang-undangan. Di WSBP, Direksi sekaligus merupakan eksekutif senior yang dipilih langsung oleh pemegang saham dan bertanggung jawab terhadap kepengurusan Perusahaan. [GRI 2-11]

Dalam menjalankan fungsinya, Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi didukung sejumlah organ. Dewan Komisaris dibantu oleh Sekretaris Dewan Komisaris, Komite Audit, Komite Pemantau Risiko dan Tata Kelola Terintegrasi, serta Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi. Komite-komite tersebut bertugas membantu Dewan Komisaris dalam mengambil keputusan mengenai topik-topik ekonomi, lingkungan dan sosial di Perusahaan dengan terlebih dahulu menyelenggarakan Rapat Komite dengan Direksi dan Manajemen. Sementara itu, Direksi didukung oleh unit fungsional yang terdiri dari Fungsi Corporate Secretary, Fungsi Internal Audit, Fungsi Kepatuhan dan Manajemen Risiko, serta Fungsi Legal. [GRI 2-9]

Based on the 2025 assessment results, the assessment of GCG implementation at WSBP has improved compared to 2024. This achievement encourages WSBP to continue enhancing GCG implementation and optimally address all recommendations from the GCG implementation assessment team for the 2025 fiscal year, in order to maintain long-term business sustainability.

# GOVERNANCE STRUCTURE [GRI 2-9, 2-11]

Based on Law of the Republic of Indonesia No. 40 of 2007 concerning Limited Liability Companies (UU PT), the Company's governance structure includes the General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS), the Board of Commissioners, and the Board of Directors. For governance management, in accordance with the Company's Articles of Association, WSBP adheres to a two-tier system: the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors, each with clear authority and responsibilities according to their respective functions, as mandated by the Company's Articles of Association and laws and regulations. At WSBP, the Board of Directors is also a senior executive directly elected by shareholders and is responsible for the management of the Company. [GRI 2-11]

In carrying out their functions, the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors are supported by several organs. The Board of Commissioners is assisted by the Secretary to the Board of Commissioners, the Audit Committee, the Integrated Risk Monitoring and Governance Committee, and the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. These committees are tasked with assisting the Board of Commissioners in making decisions on economic, environmental, and social topics within the Company by first holding Committee Meetings with the Board of Directors and Management. Meanwhile, the Board of Directors is supported by functional units consisting of the Corporate Secretary Function, Internal Audit Function, Compliance and Risk Management Function and Legal Function. # Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi

Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi dibentuk sesuai ketentuan POJK No. 34/POJK.04/2014. Pembentukan komite ditetapkan melalui Surat Keputusan Dewan Komisaris No. 11/SK/WBP/DK/2023 tanggal 12 Oktober 2023, yang memuat pengangkatan ketua dan anggota, susunan komite, serta penetapan honorarium dan tunjangan.

Pada tahun 2025, Dewan Komisaris melakukan pembaruan komposisi Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi melalui Surat Keputusan No. 14/SK/WBP/DK/2025 tanggal 22 Desember 2025, mengenai pemberhentian dan pengangkatan anggota serta penetapan susunan Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi yang baru.

# Komite Pemantau Risiko dan Tata Kelola Terintegrasi

Berdasarkan Peraturan Menteri BUMN No. PER-3/MBU/03/2023 tentang Organ dan Sumber Daya Manusia Badan Usaha Milik Negara, Komite Pemantau Risiko dan Tata Kelola Terintegrasi dibentuk untuk memperkuat pengawasan Dewan Komisaris terhadap pelaksanaan manajemen risiko dan penerapan tata kelola secara terintegrasi. Komite ini merupakan pengembangan dari Komite Pemantau Manajemen Risiko.

Perubahan nomenklatur dan susunan komite ditetapkan melalui Surat Keputusan Dewan Komisaris No. 10/SK/WBP/DK/2023 tanggal 12 Oktober 2023. Selanjutnya, Dewan Komisaris kembali memperbarui komposisi komite melalui Surat Keputusan Dewan Komisaris No. 13/SK/WBP/DK/2025 tanggal 22 Desember 2025, yang mencakup pemberhentian dan pengangkatan ketua serta anggota komite.

Komite ini bertugas memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris terkait efektivitas pelaksanaan kebijakan manajemen risiko dan kualitas pengawasan tata kelola perusahaan.

# DIREKSI [GRI 2-9]

Direksi adalah Organ Perusahaan yang memiliki wewenang dan tanggung jawab terhadap kepengurusan Perusahaan untuk kepentingan Perusahaan, sesuai dengan maksud dan tujuan Perusahaan serta mewakili Perusahaan, baik di dalam maupun di luar pengadilan sesuai dengan ketentuan Anggaran Dasar Perusahaan.

# Nomination and Remuneration Committee

The Nomination and Remuneration Committee was formed in accordance with OJK Regulation No. 34/POJK.04/2014. The committee's establishment was formalized by Board of Commissioners Decree No. 11/SK/WBP/DK/2023 dated October 12, 2023, detailing the appointment of the chair and members, the committee's composition, and the honorarium and benefits settlements.

In 2025, the Board of Commissioners updated the composition of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee through Decree No. 14/SK/WBP/DK/2025 dated December 22, 2025, concerning the dismissal and appointment of members and the establishment of the new committee structure.

Integrated Risk Monitoring and Governance Committee Based on Minister of State-Owned Enterprises Regulation No. PER-3/MBU/03/2023 on Organization and Human Resources of State-Owned Enterprises, the Integrated Risk Monitoring and Governance Committee was formed to strengthen the Board of Commissioners' oversight of risk management and the implementation of integrated governance. This committee is a development of the former Risk Management Monitoring Committee.

Changes in the nomenclature and structure of the committee were formalized through Board of Commissioners Decree No. 10/SK/WBP/DK/2023 dated October 12, 2023. Subsequently, the Board of Commissioners updated the committee's composition through Decree of the Board of Commissioners No. 13/SK/WBP/DK/2025 dated December 22, 2025, which included the dismissal and appointment of the chair and committee members.

This committee is tasked with providing recommendations to the Board of Commissioners regarding the effectiveness of risk management policies and the quality of corporate governance oversight.

# Rapat Direksi

Di sepanjang tahun 2025, Direksi telah melaksanakan rapat internal dengan rincian rapat Direksi adalah sebagai berikut:

1. Rapat Koordinasi sebanyak 1 (satu) kali
2. Rapat Direksi Terbatas sebanyak 27 (dua puluh tujuh) kali
3. Rapat Direksi sebanyak 10 (sepuluh) kali

Rapat tersebut dilaksanakan secara konsisten sesuai rencana kerja yang telah ditetapkan, dan realisasinya mencapai 100%.

# Organ Pendukung di Bawah Direksi

Untuk mengoptimalkan kinerjanya, Direksi dibantu oleh organ pendukung, yaitu Divisi Corporate Secretary dan Divisi Internal Audit.

# Divisi Corporate Secretary

WSBP membentuk Divisi Corporate Secretary berdasarkan Peraturan Menteri BUMN No. PER-02/MBU/03/2023 tentang Pedoman Tata Kelola dan Kegiatan Korporasi Signifikan Badan Usaha Milik Negara dan Peraturan OJK No. 35/POJK.04/2014 tentang Sekretaris Perusahaan Emiten atau Perusahaan Publik.

Divisi Corporate Secretary memiliki tanggung jawab esensial dalam menjalin komunikasi yang efektif antara perusahaan, pemegang saham, regulator, serta pemangku kepentingan lainnya. Fungsi utama Divisi Corporate Secretary adalah memastikan bahwa seluruh aktivitas perusahaan berjalan sesuai dengan ketentuan hukum yang berlaku, serta mendukung keterbukaan informasi yang transparan dan akurat. Divisi Corporate Secretary dipimpin oleh seorang Kepala Divisi yang memiliki peran strategis dalam mengelola hubungan eksternal, memperkuat kepercayaan publik, dan menjaga kepatuhan terhadap regulasi pasar modal yang dinamis.

# Board of Directors Meetings

Throughout 2025, the Board of Directors held internal meetings with the following breakdown:

1. 1 (one) time Coordination Meeting
2. 27 (twenty-seven) times Limited Board of Directors Meeting
3. 10 (ten) times Board of Directors Meeting

These meetings were conducted consistently in accordance with the established work plan, with a realization rate of 100%.

# Supporting Organs Under the Board of Directors

To optimize its performance, the Board of Directors is assisted by supporting organs, namely Corporate Secretary Division and Internal Audit Division.

# Corporate Secretary Division

WSBP established Corporate Secretary Division in accordance with the Minister of State-Owned Enterprises Regulation No. PER-02/MBU/03/2023 on Guidelines for Governance and Significant Corporate Activities of State-Owned Enterprises, and OJK Regulation No. 35/POJK.04/2014 concerning Corporate Secretary of Issuers or Public Companies.

Corporate Secretary Division plays a vital role in facilitating effective communication between the Company, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders. Its primary function is to ensure that all Company activities comply with applicable laws and to support transparent and accurate information disclosure. Corporate Secretary Division is led by a Vice President who holds a strategic role in managing external relations, strengthening public trust, and ensuring compliance with evolving capital market regulations.

# NOMINATION AND SELECTION OF THE BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS AND BOARD OF DIRECTORS [GRI 2-10]

## Board of Commissioners

The Board of Commissioners is appointed and dismissed by the GMS, with due consideration to the Company's vision, mission, and strategic plans to enable effective, prompt, and independent decision-making. Candidates for the Board of Commissioners are selected based on the Company's needs and must meet key criteria, including expertise, integrity, leadership, experience, honesty, good character, and a strong dedication to advancing and developing the Company.

Members of the Board of Commissioners may be dismissed at any time by a GMS resolution stating the reasons for dismissal. Grounds for dismissal including:

1. Failure to perform duties properly
2. Failure to comply with laws and regulations and/or the provisions of Company's Articles of Association
3. Involvement in actions detrimental to the SOE and/or the state's finances
4. Engaging in conduct that violates the ethics and/or compliance standards expected of a member of the Board of Commissioners/Supervisory Board of SOE
5. Designated as a suspect or defendant by the competent authorities
6. Found guilty by a court decision that has become final and binding

In addition, members of the Board of Commissioners may be dismissed by the General Meeting of Shareholders based on other grounds deemed appropriate by the General Meeting of Shareholders in the best interests of the Company.

Based on the Company's Articles of Association, members of the Board of Commissioners are appointed and dismissed by the GMS. This appointment is effective from the date specified in the GMS where the Board of Commissioners was appointed and ends with a 1 (one) year period. # MANAJEMEN RISIKO [OJK E.3] [GRI 2-23]

Perusahaan memahami bisnis yang dijalankan dihadapkan dengan berbagai risiko. Mengatasi hal itu, WSBP menerapkan system manajemen risiko secara terintegrasi dalam setiap aspek operasional. Langkah strategis tersebut dilakukan sebagai bentuk pelaksanaan komitmen prinsip-prinsip GCG sekaligus upaya mengantisipasi risiko yang berpotensi menghambat pencapaian Perusahaan, yang pada akhirnya menciptakan nilai jangka panjang, baik bagi pemegang saham maupun seluruh pemangku kepentingan.

WSBP menerapkan system manajemen risiko yang tidak hanya berpedoman pada kebijakan internal Perusahaan, tetapi juga mengikuti standar internasional yang berlaku. WSBP mengintegrasikan COSO Enterprise Risk Management – Integrated Framework (COSO ERM) yang dikembangkan oleh The Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO) dan ISO 31000:2018 tentang Risk Management – Principles and Guidelines dalam setiap tahapan pengelolaan risiko. Kepatuhan terhadap standar berlaku ini menunjukkan komitmen WSBP untuk menciptakan tata kelola yang transparan dan solid, serta memberikan landasan yang kuat dalam pengelolaan manajemen risiko secara holistik.

Proses penerapan manajemen risiko di WSBP melibatkan setiap unit di seluruh organisasi, untuk bertanggung jawab melakukan identifikasi, analisis, evaluasi, serta memantau potensi risiko yang dapat mempengaruhi pencapaian tujuan strategis Perusahaan. WSBP tidak hanya memastikan bahwa manajemen risiko dijalankan secara efektif dan efisien, tetapi juga berupaya membangun budaya pengelolaan risiko yang proaktif, yang akan semakin memperkuat daya saing Perusahaan di pasar yang semakin kompleks.

Untuk memastikan sistem manajemen risiko yang dijalankan Perusahaan tetap relevan dan efektif, WSBP secara berkala melakukan evaluasi dan pembaruan terhadap kebijakan manajemen risikonya. Dengan demikian Perusahaan dapat menghadapi dinamika pasar yang terus berkembang, inovasi produk yang berkelanjutan, serta perubahan regulasi yang terus berlangsung.

# RISK MANAGEMENT [OJK E.3] [GRI 2-23]

The Company understands that its business is faced with various risks. To address this, WSBP implements an integrated risk management system in every operational aspect. This strategic step is implemented as a form of commitment to GCG principles and an effort to anticipate risks that could potentially hinder the Company's achievements, ultimately creating long-term value for both shareholders and all stakeholders.

WSBP implements a risk management system that is guided not only by the Company's internal policies but also adheres to applicable international standards. WSBP integrates the COSO Enterprise Risk Management – Integrated Framework (COSO ERM) developed by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO) and ISO 31000:2018 on Risk Management – Principles and Guidelines into every stage of risk management. Compliance with these applicable standards demonstrates WSBP's commitment to creating transparent and solid governance and provides a strong foundation for holistic risk management.

The risk management implementation process at WSBP involves every unit across the organization, responsible for identifying, analyzing, evaluating, and monitoring potential risks that could impact the achievement of the Company's strategic objectives. WSBP not only ensures that risk management is implemented effectively and efficiently, but also strives to build a proactive risk management culture, which will further strengthen the Company's competitiveness in an increasingly complex market.

To ensure the Company's risk management system remains relevant and effective, WSBP periodically evaluates and updates its risk management policies. This allows the Company to address evolving market dynamics, ongoing product innovation, and ongoing regulatory changes.

Menurut ISO 31073:2022 orang atau entitas dengan akuntabilitas dan kewenangan untuk mengelola risiko disebut dengan pemilik risiko (risk owner), Dalam hal mencapai sasaran/target dan keterkaitan erat antara risiko dengan sasaran/target, make individu atau entitas pemilik sasaran/target adalah pemilik risiko (risk owner) yang memiliki tanggung jawab/akuntabilitas untuk memastikan ketepatan pengelolaan risiko.

Pengelolaan risiko harus ditentukan kepemilikan risikonya hingga tingkat yang paling rendah sesuai hierarki kepemilikan risiko. Hierarki kepemilikan risiko adalah jenjang atau tingkat kepemilikan risiko yang ditetapkan berdasarkan struktur organisasi, proses kerja, dan kepemilikan sasaran/target Perusahaan. Namun, setiap tingkatan Organisasi tentunya memiliki jenis risiko yang berbeda sesuai dengan wewenang, tugas, dan tanggung jawab yang diemban. Komunikasi Manajemen Risiko yang dibangun antara setiap tingkatan kepemilikan risiko mengikuti garis komando, akuntabilitas, koordinasi sebagaimana diatur dalam Organisasi dan tata kerja.

WSBP membagi 4 (empat) jenjang/tingkatan hierarki kepemilikan risiko sebagai berikut:

a. Risk Principle

Risk Principle adalah pejabat setingkat Direksi yang merupakan pemilik risiko tertinggi di Perusahaan dan bertanggung jawab atas pengelolaan risiko secara keseluruhan dalam Perusahaan. Risk Principle memiliki wewenang dan tanggung jawab yang tinggi dalam membuat keputusan strategis terkait risiko sebagai berikut:

i) Mengambil keputusan Perusahaan yang bersifat strategis dengan mempertimbangkan aspek risiko di tingkat Perusahaan;
ii) Memastikan pelaksanaan manajemen risiko secara menyeluruh telah berjalan sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku;
iii) Menyusun kebijakan risiko dan strategi pengelolaan risiko Perusahaan;
iv) Memastikan bahwa pengelolaan risiko terintegrasi dalam perencanaan strategis Perusahaan;
v) Mengidentifikasi risiko-risiko utama yang mempengaruhi keseluruhan Perusahaan; dan
vi) Menilai efektivitas pengelolaan risiko dan kepatuhan terhadap kebijakan risiko.

According to ISO 31073:2022, a person or entity with the accountability and authority to manage risk is referred to as a risk owner. In relation to the achievement of objectives/targets and the close linkage between risks and such objectives/targets, the individual or entity responsible for the objectives/targets shall be designated as the risk owner, who bears the responsibility and accountability to ensure the proper management of risks.

Risk management shall establish risk ownership down to the lowest level in accordance with the risk ownership hierarchy. The risk ownership hierarchy refers to the levels of risk ownership determined based on the organizational structure, work processes, and ownership of the Company's objectives/targets. Each organizational level carries different types of risks in line with its respective authority, duties, and responsibilities. Risk Management Communication established across all levels of risk ownership follows the lines of command, accountability, and coordination as defined in the organizational structure and working procedures.

WSBP establishes 4 (four) levels of risk ownership hierarchy as follows:

a. Risk Principle

Risk Principle is a director-level official who holds the highest risk profile in the Company and is responsible for overall risk management within the Company. The Risk Principle has significant authority and responsibility for making strategic decisions related to the risks, as follows:

i) Make strategic Company decisions by considering risk aspects at the Company level;
ii) Ensure that the overall implementation of risk management is in accordance with applicable regulations;
iii) Develop the Company's risk policy and risk management strategy;
iv) Ensure that risk management is integrated into the Company's strategic planning;
v) Identify key risks affecting the Company as a whole; and
vi) Assess the effectiveness of risk management and compliance with risk policies.

b. Risk Associate

Risk Associate adalah pejabat setingkat di bawah Direksi (BOD-1) yang membantu Risk Principle. Kewenangan dan tanggung jawab Risk Associate adalah sebagai berikut:

i) Mengambil keputusan Perusahaan yang bersifat operasional di tingkat Unit Kerja/Unit Bisnis dengan mempertimbangkan aspek risiko di tingkat Perusahaan;
ii) Melaksanakan praktik manajemen risiko berjalan dengan baik pada level Unit Kerja/Unit Bisnis sesuai dengan ketentuan Perusahaan yang berlaku;
iii) Mengomunikasikan kepada Unit Kerja/Unit Bisnis lain perihal aspek risiko yang dalam proses pengelolaan risiko memiliki keterkaitan dengan Unit Kerja/Unit Bisnis tersebut; dan
iv) Memantau perkembangan dan efektivitas pengelolaan risiko dan melaporkan kepada Risk Principle.

c. Risk Agent

Risk Agent adalah pejabat setingkat Manajer (BOD-2) yang membantu Risk Associate. Kewenangan dan tanggung jawab Risk Agent adalah sebagai berikut:

i) Mengambil keputusan Perusahaan yang bersifat operasional di tingkat Unit Kerja/Unit Bisnis dengan mempertimbangkan aspek risiko di tingkat Perusahaan;
ii) Melaksanakan praktik manajemen risiko berjalan dengan baik pada level Unit Kerja/Unit Bisnis sesuai dengan ketentuan Perusahaan yang berlaku;
iii) Mengomunikasikan kepada Unit Kerja/Unit Bisnis lain perihal aspek risiko yang dalam proses pengelolaan risiko memiliki keterkaitan dengan Unit Kerja/Unit Bisnis tersebut; dan
iv) Melaporkan kepada Risk Associate dan Risk Principle tentang perkembangan dan kendala yang terkait dengan risiko.

d. Risk Officer

Risk Officer adalah pejabat yang sekurang kurangnya setingkat staf yang membantu Risk Agent dalam melaksanakan praktik manajemen risiko. Tugas dan kewenangan Risk Officer adalah sebagai berikut:

i) Melaksanakan proses identifikasi, analisa, dan pengelolaan risiko pada wilayah kerjanya; dan
ii) Memastikan ketentuan Perusahaan bidang manajemen risiko telah berjalan dengan baik sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku.

b. Risk Associate

Risk Associate is an official one level below the Board of Directors (BOD-1) who assists the Risk Principle. The Risk Associate's authority and responsibilities are as follows:

i) Make operational Company decisions at the Work Unit/Business Unit level, taking into account risk aspects at the Company level;
ii) Implement effective risk management practices at the Work Unit/Business Unit level in accordance with applicable Company regulations;
iii) Communicate to other Work Units/Business Units regarding risk aspects that are relevant to the Work Unit/Business Unit in the risk management process; and
iv) Monitor the progress and effectiveness of risk management and reporting to the Risk Principle.

c. Risk Agent

Risk Agent is a Manager-level official (BOD-2) who assists a Risk Associate. The Risk Agent's authority and responsibilities are as follows:

i) Make operational Company decisions at the Work Unit/Business Unit level, taking into account risk aspects at the Company level;
ii) Implement effective risk management practices at the Work Unit/Business Unit level in accordance with applicable Company regulations;
iii) Communicate to other Work Units/Business Units regarding risk aspects that are relevant to the Work Unit/Business Unit in the risk management process; and
iv) Report to the Risk Associate and Risk Principle regarding developments and challenges related to risk.

d. Risk Officer

Risk Officer is an official at least at staff level who assists the Risk Agent in implementing risk management practices. The duties and authorities of a Risk Officer are as follows:

i) Implement risk identification, analysis, and management processes within its work area; and
ii) Ensure that the Company's risk management provisions are implemented properly in accordance with applicable regulations.

MANAJEMEN RISIKO

Manajemen risiko merupakan salah satu aspek yang penting bagi Perusahaan dalam memastikan kelangsungan bisnisnya. WSBP berkomitmen untuk selalu meningkatkan operasi bisnis Perusahaan dalam hal:

1. Menerapkan pengelolaan risiko secara terpadu sesuai dengan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik (Good Corporate Governance) untuk mencapai sasaran dan tujuan Perusahaan.
2. Meningkatkan kesadaran berbudaya risiko dalam setiap aktivitas pekerjaan sehingga menjadi bagian yang terintegrasi dengan proses bisnis Perusahaan.
3. Selalu mempertimbangkan risiko di dalam setiap pengambilan keputusan pada level strategis dan operasional sesuai dengan toleransi risiko yang sudah ditetapkan.

5. Mengembangkan kompetensi Human Capital pengelola risiko, menyediakan anggaran pengelolaan risiko, serta menyediakan dukungan teknologi informasi untuk pengelolaan risiko secara memadai.

STATEMENT BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND/OR BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS OR AUDIT COMMITTEE ON THE ADEQUACY OF THE RISK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM

Risk management is a critical aspect for the Company in ensuring its business continuity. WSBP is committed to continuously improving the Company's business operations by:

1. Implementing integrated risk management in accordance with Good Corporate Governance to achieve the Company's goals and objectives.
2. Increasing awareness of risk culture in every work activity so that it becomes an integrated part of the Company's business processes.
3. Always considering risk in every decision-making process at the strategic and operational levels in accordance with established risk tolerances.
4. Always informing the Company of risk events that cause losses or opportunities by requiring risk managers at every organizational level to conduct risk identification, analysis, and evaluation processes and to periodically report on the implementation of risk control and handling as evaluation material for the ongoing risk management process.
5. Developing the competency of Human Capital for risk management, allocate a risk management budget, and provide adequate information technology support for risk management.
6. Using the results of the risk register as a basis for audits and supervision to improve performance and accountability.

# KONFLIK KEPENTINGAN [GRI 2-15, 2-23, 2-24]

Perusahaan telah memiliki Code of Conduct (Kode Etik) sebagai pedoman perilaku bagi seluruh Insan WSBP dalam menegakkan Etika Bekerja dan Etika Berbisnis. Kode Etik WSBP diperbarui melalui Keputusan Direksi WSBP No. 202/SK/WBP/PEN/2025 tentang Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku (Code of Conduct) WSBP. Pedoman Kode Etik WSBP dapat diakses dan diunduh melalui: https://waskitaprecast.co.id/ethical-standards.

Pedoman Benturan Kepentingan tahun 2025 masih dalam tahap penyusunan seiring dengan penyusunan Laporan Tahunan 2025 WSBP. Pedoman terkait benturan kepentingan dalam lingkungan Perusahaan diatur dengan ketentuan sebagai berikut:

1. Benturan kepentingan adalah situasi/kondisi yang memungkinkan setiap Insan WSBP memanfaatkan kedudukan dan wewenang yang dimilikinya dalam Perusahaan untuk kepentingan pribadi, keluarga, atau golongan, sehingga tugas yang diamanatkan tidak dapat dilakukan secara objektif.
2. Perusahaan mengembangkan pedoman kepentingan yang memastikan seluruh Dewan Komisaris, Direksi dan para Insan WSBP mencegah diri dari pelaksanaan transaksi yang mengandung benturan kepentingan tanpa persetujuan terlebih dahulu dari para Pemegang Saham.
3. Anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi harus mengungkapkan kepemilikan saham di perusahaan lain dalam daftar khusus sebagaimana dipersyaratkan oleh peraturan dan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.
4. Dewan Komisaris, Direksi dan Pegawai dilarang terlibat/ berpartisipasi dalam setiap situasi di mana terdapat potensi pertentangan antara kepentingan pribadi dengan kepentingan profesional individu atau perusahaan yang terlibat dalam proses perolehan proyek/pekerjaan, dan proses keuangan.
5. Perusahaan akan mengingatkan seluruh Insan WSBP, pada segala tingkatan, untuk menyadari kebijakan benturan kepentingan. Setiap Insan WSBP harus melaporkan dan mengungkapkan secara lengkap setiap kegiatan yang berpotensi mengandung benturan kepentingan.
6. Seluruh transaksi yang mengandung benturan kepentingan yang terjadi antara Perusahaan dan para Insan WSBP, Anggota Direksi, dan Dewan Komisaris harus diungkapkan secara penuh kepada Pemegang Saham.

# CONFLICT OF INTEREST [GRI 2-15, 2-23, 2-24]

The Company has established a Code of Conduct as a behavioral guideline for all Insan WSBP in upholding both work and business ethics. The WSBP Code of Conduct was updated through Board of Directors Decree No. 202/SK/WBP/PEN/2025 concerning the WSBP Code of Conduct. The WSBP Code of Conduct can be accessed and downloaded at: https://waskitaprecast.co.id/ethical-standards

The 2025 Conflict of Interest Guidelines are still being drafted in conjunction with the preparation of WSBP's 2025 Annual Report. Guidelines regarding conflicts of interest within the Company are governed by the following provisions:

1. A conflict of interest refers to any situation or condition that may enable any Insan WSBP to utilize their position and authority within the Company for personal, family, or group interests, thereby compromising the objectivity in carrying out their assigned duties.
2. The Company develops conflict of interest guidelines to ensure that all members of the Board of Commissioners, Board of Directors, and Insan WSBP refrain from engaging in transactions involving conflicts of interest without prior approval from the Shareholders.
3. Members of the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors must disclose share ownership in other companies in a special register as required by applicable laws and regulations.
4. The Board of Commissioners, Board of Directors, and Insan WSBP are prohibited from being involved or participating in any situation where there is a potential conflict between personal interests and the professional interests of the individual or the Company, particularly in project procurement and financial processes.
5. The Company continuously reminds all Insan WSBP at all levels to be aware of the conflict of interest policy. Each Insan WSBP is required to fully report and disclose any activities that may potentially involve a conflict of interest.
6. All transactions involving a conflict of interest between the Company and Insan WSBP, members of the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners must be fully disclosed to Shareholders.

# KEBIJAKAN ANTI KORUPSI

Perusahaan berkomitmen menjalankan seluruh kegiatan usaha secara berintegritas dan transparan. Perusahaan menentang keras segala bentuk korupsi, suap, gratifikasi, pemerasan, maupun praktik tidak etis lainnya, serta menerapkan kebijakan zero tolerance terhadap pelanggaran etika dan hukum. Untuk memperkuat komitmen tersebut, Perusahaan memiliki Kebijakan Anti Penyuaapan yang telah ditetapkan melalui Surat Keputusan Direksi No. 159/SK/WBP/PEN/2024, yang berisi:

1. Menerapkan Sistem Manajemen Anti Penyuaapan dan mematuhi Peraturan Perundang-undangan yang berlaku di bidang penyuaapan yang melingkupi suap dan gratifikasi di area WSBP.
2. Melibatkan seluruh Insan WSBP dalam mencegah, mendeteksi, melaporkan, dan menangani tindakan penyuaapan tanpa rasa takut tindakan balasan.
3. Menetapkan wewenang dan kemandirian Fungsi Kepatuhan Sistem Manajemen Anti Penyuaapan.
4. Berkomitmen untuk melakukan perbaikan berkelanjutan terhadap keefektifan Sistem Manajemen Anti Penyuaapan.
5. Bersedia menerima konsekuensi sesuai dengan peraturan perundangan yang berlaku jika implementasi sistem tidak sesuai dengan kebijakan anti penyuaapan yang telah ditetapkan.

# ANTI-CORRUPTION POLICY

The Company is committed to conducting all business activities with integrity and transparency. The Company strongly opposes all forms of corruption, bribery, gratuities, extortion, or other unethical practices, and implements a zero-tolerance policy for ethical and legal violations. To strengthen this commitment, the Company has an Anti-Bribery Policy, established through Board of Directors' Decree No. 159/SK/WBP/PEN/2024, which contains:

1. Implementing an Anti-Bribery Management System and complying with applicable laws and regulations in the field of bribery, which cover bribery and gratuities within the WSBP area.
2. Involving all Insan WSBP in preventing, detecting, reporting, and handling acts of bribery without fear of retaliation.
3. Establishing the authority and independence of the Anti-Bribery Management System Compliance Function.
4. Committing to continuous improvement of the effectiveness of the Anti-Bribery Management System.
5. Willing to accept the consequences in accordance with applicable laws and regulations if the system implementation does not comply with the established anti-bribery policy.
