# KEBIJAKAN PENGENDALIAN GRATIFIKASI [GRI 2-23]

WSBP berkomitmen untuk mencegah segala bentuk gratifikasi di lingkungan Perusahaan, baik dari manajemen puncak hingga level pegawai. Komitmen tersebut dibuktikan dengan diiraihnya Sertifikasi Sistem Manajemen Anti Penyuapan (Anti Bribery Management System) ISO 37001:2016 dan Surat Keputusan Direksi No. 35/SK/WBP/ PEN/2024 tentang Pedoman Pengendalian Gratifikasi PT Waskita Beton Precast Tbk. Gratifikasi dilarang sepenuhnya oleh WSBP karena sangat potensial memicu terjadinya konflik kepentingan serta mengurangi objektivitas dan profesionalitas Insan WSBP. Sosialisasi larangan tentang gratifikasi serta pentingnya integritas atau kejujuran terus dilakukan oleh WSBP, termasuk mengenai sanksi yang akan dijatuhkan apabila ada yang terbukti menerima gratifikasi.

Panduan tentang Pengendalian Gratifikasi di WSBP dibuat untuk mengatur hubungan bisnis seluruh Insan WSBP dengan pihak-pihak lain (Pihak Pertama maupun Pihak Ketiga). Pengendalian gratifikasi sangat penting karena gratifikasi dapat menjadi tindak pidana suap dan merupakan salah satu tindakan korupsi yang dapat memberikan dampak hukum sekaligus pencitraan negatif bagi perusahaan. Pada tahun 2025 Perusahaan telah melaksanakan berbagai inisiatif untuk mensosialisasikan larangan gratifikasi dan korupsi. Selain melalui website Perusahaan, sosialisasi dilakukan dengan mengeluarkan Surat Keputusan Direksi No. 35/SK/WBP/PEN/2024 tentang Pedoman Pengendalian Gratifikasi (GTF). Upaya ini diperkuat melalui sosialisasi secara langsung oleh Direksi kepada seluruh Insan WSBP dalam Rapat Koordinasi yang dilaksanakan setiap triwulan. Sosialisasi juga dilakukan melalui presentasi mengenai larangan gratifikasi oleh Tim Auditor Internal kepada Auditee pada saat pelaksanaan kegiatan audit internal. Pendekatan ini diharapkan dapat meningkatkan pemahaman dan kepatuhan seluruh pihak terhadap prinsip pengendalian gratifikasi di Perusahaan. Panduan gratifikasi WSBP terakhir diperbarui pada tahun 2024, dan dapat diakses melalui https://waskitaprecast.co.id/gratification.

To build an anti-corruption culture, in 2025, WSBP conducted anti-corruption outreach and training for all Insan WSBP, including the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors.

# GRATIFICATION CONTROL POLICY [GRI 2-23]

WSBP is committed to preventing all forms of gratifications within the Company, from top management to employee levels. This commitment is demonstrated by the achievement of the ISO 37001:2016 Anti-Bribery Management System Certification and the Decree of the Board of Directors No. 35/SK/WBP/PEN/2024 concerning Guidelines for Gratification Control at PT Waskita Beton Precast Tbk. Gratification are completely prohibited by WSBP due to their potential to trigger conflicts of interest and undermine the objectivity and professionalism of Insan WSBP. WSBP continues to disseminate information about the prohibition on gratification and the importance of integrity and honesty, including the sanctions that will be imposed if anyone is proven to have received a gratification.

The WSBP Gratification Control Guidelines were created to regulate the business relationships of all Insan WSBP with other parties (both First Parties and Third Parties). Gratification control is crucial because gratuity can constitute a criminal act of bribery and is a form of corruption that can have legal repercussions and negatively impact the Company's image. In 2025, the Company implemented various initiatives to disseminate information about the prohibition on gratification and corruption. In addition to the Company's website, this dissemination was carried out through the issuance of Decree of the Board of Directors No. 35/SK/WBP/PEN/2024 concerning the Gratification Control Guidelines (GTF). This effort was strengthened through direct dissemination by the Board of Directors to all Insan WSBP during quarterly Coordination Meetings. Dissemination was also conducted through presentations on the prohibition on gratification by the Internal Audit Team to auditees during internal audit activities. This approach is expected to increase understanding and compliance of all parties with the principles of gratification control within the Company. The WSBP Gratification Guidelines were last updated in 2024 and can be accessed at https://waskitaprecast.co.id/gratification.

# SEKILAS KONDISI EKONOMI NASIONAL DAN GLOBAL

Perekonomian global sepanjang tahun 2025 bergerak dinamis dan tidak pasti. Perang dagang kembali menjadi alat tekanan geopolitik, dan arus perdagangan global semakin terfragmentasi. Kebijakan moneter di negara maju yang kerap berubah, adanya fluktuasi arus modal, serta konflik geopolitik turut memperbesar volatilitas pasar keuangan global.

Di tengah situasi global yang penuh tantangan, ekonomi Indonesia sepanjang 2025 masih menunjukkan ketahanan yang relatif kuat. Meski tidak tumbuh tinggi, ekonomi Indonesia konsisten meningkat dan membaik di tiap triwulannya.

# BRIEF OVERVIEW OF GLOBAL AND NATIONAL ECONOMY

Throughout 2025, the global economy stirred dynamically and uncertainly. Trade wars once again became a tool of geopolitical pressure, and global trade flows became increasingly fragmented. Frequent changes in monetary policies in developed countries, fluctuations in capital flows, and geopolitical conflicts contributed to increasing volatility in global financial markets.

The Indonesian economy still demonstrated relatively strong resilience amid the challenging global situation throughout 2025. Although not experiencing high growth, the Indonesian economy consistently increased and improved each quarter.

Pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional terjadi pada hampir seluruh lapangan usaha, kecuali Pertambangan dan Penggalian yang terkontraksi sebesar 0,66%. Lapangan usaha yang tumbuh signifikan adalah Jasa Lainnya sebesar 9,93%; diikuti oleh Jasa Perusahaan sebesar 9,10%; serta Transportasi dan Pergudangan sebesar 8,78%. Sementara itu, Industri Pengolahan; serta Perdagangan Besar dan Eceran, Reparasi Mobil dan Sepeda Motor yang memiliki peran dominan terhadap perekonomian Indonesia masing-masing tumbuh sebesar 5,30% dan 5,49%.

Selama tahun 2025, kelompok provinsi di Pulau Jawa mendominasi ekonomi Indonesia secara spasial dengan kontribusi mencapai 56,93% dan mencatat pertumbuhan sebesar 5,30% (c-to-c).

# BIDANG KONSTRUKSI TAHUN 2025

Sektor infrastruktur, khususnya konstruksi, menjadi motor penting bagi pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional. Dari tahun ke tahun sektor konstruksi di Indonesia terus mengalami pertumbuhan signifikan. Kementerian Keuangan menyatakan bahwa sektor konstruksi pada tahun 2025 mencatat pertumbuhan 4,21%, didukung oleh percepatan pembangunan infrastruktur dalam Proyek Strategis Nasional (PSN), yang selaras dengan Asta Cita Presiden Prabowo Subianto. Dengan demikian, sektor konstruksi tidak hanya menyerap tenaga kerja, tetapi juga memperkuat fondasi untuk pertumbuhan ekonomi tinggi dalam jangka panjang.

Dengan pertumbuhan tersebut, kontribusi sektor konstruksi dalam perekonomian Indonesia berada pada urutan keempat yang dilihat dari persentase sektor konstruksi pada Produk Domestik Bruto (PDB) Indonesia sebesar 9,84% pada triwulan I tahun 2025.

National economic growth occurred across almost all business sectors, with the exception of Mining and Quarrying, which contracted by 0.66%. Business sectors with significant growth were Other Services at 9.93%, followed by Corporate Services at 9.10%, and Transportation and Warehousing at 8.78%. Meanwhile, the Manufacturing Industry, Wholesale and Retail Trade, and Automobile and Motorcycle Repair, which played a dominant role in the Indonesian economy, grew by 5.30% and 5.49%, respectively.

Through 2025, the Javanese provinces dominated the Indonesian economy spatially, contributing 56.93% and recording 5.30% growth (c-to-c).

# CONSTRUCTION SECTOR PERFORMANCE IN 2025

The infrastructure sector, particularly construction, is a crucial driver of national economic growth. Indonesia's construction sector continues to experience significant growth year after year. The Ministry of Finance stated that the construction sector recorded a 4.21% growth in 2025, supported by accelerated infrastructure development within the National Strategic Projects (PSN), which aligned with President Prabowo Subianto's Asta Cita program. Thus, the construction sector will not only absorb labor but also strengthen the foundation for high, long-term economic growth.

With this growth, the construction sector's contribution to the Indonesian economy ranks fourth, as seen from its percentage share of Indonesia's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) at 9.84% in the first quarter of 2025.

# PROGRAM PENSIUN PEGAWAI

Perusahaan memiliki program pensiun sebagai bentuk pemenuhan hak pegawai. Perusahaan memiliki program pensiun yang dirancang sesuai dengan ketentuan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Program pensiun memberikan manfaat finansial bagi Insan WSBP setelah masa kerja mereka berakhir sebagai bentuk aprèsiasi atas kontribusi mereka selama bekerja.

WSBP menetapkan Program Pensiun Pegawai sebagai bagian dari komitmen Perusahaan dalam memberikan kepastian dan kesejahteraan bagi pegawai memasuki masa purna tugas. Ketentuan ini mengacu pada Surat Keputusan Direksi No. 129.1/SK/WBP/PEN/2023 tanggal 25 Agustus 2023.

Berdasarkan ketentuan tersebut, usia pensiun pegawai ditetapkan pada 55 (lima puluh lima) tahun, yang dihitung hingga tanggal 1 (satu) bulan berikutnya setelah hari lahir pegawai. Menjelang masa pensiun, pegawai akan memperoleh pemberitahuan resmi serta keputusan terkait pengakhiran hubungan kerja sesuai dengan peraturan yang berlaku.

# EMPLOYEE RETIREMENT PROGRAM

The Company has a pension program to fulfill employee rights, designed in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The pension program provides financial benefits to Insan WSBP after their working period ends as a form of appreciation for their contributions during their tenure.

WSBP has established the Employee Retirement Program as part of the Company's commitment to providing security and well-being for employees entering retirement. These provisions are based on Board of Directors Decision No. 129.1/SK/WBP/PEN/2023 dated August 25, 2023.

Under these provisions, the retirement age for employees is set at 55 (fifty-five) years, calculated as of the first day of the month following the employee's birthday. Prior to retirement, employees will receive official notification and a decision regarding the termination of their employment in accordance with applicable regulations.

# PENGUNGKAPAN KERANGKA GOVERNANSI, PENGELOLAAN, DAN PENGENDALIAN ASPEK PERPAJAKAN

Komitmen WSBP untuk berkontribusi terhadap pembangunan dibuktikan melalui ketaatan dalam pembayaran pajak. Sepanjang tahun 2025 Perusahaan menjalankan kepatuhan terhadap peraturan dan memenuhi kewajiban pajak sesuai dengan hukum dan peraturan yang berlaku. Atas upaya tersebut, Perusahaan tidak menerima peringatan apapun atau sanksi signifikan terkait dengan perpajakan sampai dengan 31 Desember 2025. Pengelolaan pajak di WSBP dilakukan oleh Divisi Keuangan dan Akuntansi, di bawah Direktur Keuangan, Manajemen Risiko & Legal, yang sekaligus merupakan badan tata kelola tertinggi yang secara resmi meninjau dan menyetujui strategi pajak Perusahaan.

Berkaitan dengan laporan pajak, Perusahaan hanya beroperasi di Indonesia dan tidak memiliki cabang atau kantor operasional di luar negeri. Dengan demikian, laporan perpajakan hanya dilakukan untuk Indonesia. Per 31 Desember 2025, Perusahaan telah membayarkan pajak PPh 4(2) PPh 15, PPh 21, PPh 23, dan PPN dengan total sebesar Rp43,61 miliar, menurun dibandingkan tahun 2024 dengan pembayaran pajak sebesar Rp49,51 miliar.

In addition to complying with applicable regulations, the principle of healthy competition that WSBP upholds also refers to the Code of Conduct, which contains WSBP's attitude that supports the principles of fair business competition. The Company's consistency in conducting business while upholding the principle of fair competition has resulted in the absence of legal actions or sanctions from the Business Competition Supervisory Commission (KPPU) as an authority authorized to deal with alleged monopolistic practices and/or unfair business competition. In addition, WSBP also did not receive any sanctions or fines for violating anti-trust and monopoly regulations in Indonesia and other countries where WSBP is working on a project. [GRI 2-27, 206-1]

# DISCLOSURES OF GOVERNANCE FRAMEWORK, MANAGEMENT, AND CONTROL OF TAX ASPECTS

WSBP's commitment to contributing to development is demonstrated through its compliance with tax payments. Throughout 2025, the Company has complied with all regulations and fulfilled its tax obligations in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations of the Republic of Indonesia. As such, the Company did not receive any warnings or significant sanctions related to taxation until December 31, 2025. Tax management at WSBP is handled by the Finance and Accounting Division, under the Director of Finance, Risk Management & Legal, who is also the highest governance body that formally reviews and approves the Company's tax strategy.

Regarding tax reporting, the Company only operates in Indonesia and has no branches or operational offices abroad. Therefore, tax reports are only made for Indonesia. As of December 31, 2025, the Company has paid taxes, including Income Tax 4(2), Income Tax 15, Income Tax 21, Income Tax 23, and VAT totaling Rp43.61 billion, a decrease compared to 2024, which had tax payments of Rp49.51 billion.

# PEREKRUTAN DAN PERGANTIAN PEGAWAI

Proses rekrutmen yang dijalankan Perusahaan selain menjunjung tinggi prinsip kesetaraan juga dijalankan secara transparan dan berbasis kompetensi. Hal ini untuk memastikan bahwa setiap individu yang bergabung memiliki kemampuan yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan Perusahaan. Proses rekrutmen dilakukan melalui seleksi ketat dalam rangka mendapatkan kandidat terbaik, sehingga Perusahaan dapat memperkuat sinergi tim, dan mendorong produktivitas yang berkelanjutan.

Di sisi lain, WSBP juga memantau tingkat turnover pegawai secara berkala sebagai bagian dari upaya menjaga stabilitas tenaga kerja. Dengan menganalisis penyebab turnover, Perusahaan dapat merancang strategi retensi, seperti peningkatan kesejahteraan, pengembangan karier, dan penciptaan lingkungan kerja yang kondusif. Melalui pendekatan ini, WSBP berupaya mempertahankan Insan WSBP berkualitas sekaligus memastikan keberlanjutan dan efisiensi operasional Perusahaan.

Mekanisme rekrutmen di WSBP mengadopsi 2 (dua) jenis program, yaitu: [GRI 3-3]

1. Rekrutmen Pegawai Tidak Tetap (PTT)

Proses ini diselenggarakan secara terpusat dan dikoordinasikan oleh Divisi Human Capital Management. Proses rekrutmen melalui Program PTT dilakukan melalui tahap seleksi administrasi, tes psikologis, tes kesehatan, dan wawancara.

# EMPLOYEE RECRUITMENT AND TURNOVER

The recruitment process carried out by the Company not only upholds the principle of equality but is also conducted transparently and based on competency. This is to ensure that every individual who joins possesses abilities that align with the Company's needs. The recruitment process is conducted through rigorous selection to obtain the best candidates, enabling the Company to strengthen team synergy and drive sustainable productivity.

On the other hand, WSBP also regularly monitors employee turnover rates as part of efforts to maintain workforce stability. By analyzing the causes of turnover, the Company can design retention strategies, such as improving welfare, career development, and creating a conducive work environment. Through this approach, WSBP strives to retain quality Insan WSBP while ensuring the continuity and efficiency of the Company's operations.

The recruitment mechanism at WSBP adopts 2 (two) types of programs, namely: [GRI 3-3]

This is one of the Company's new employee recruitment programs aimed at meeting long-term employee needs by selecting fresh graduates from reputable universities/ other educational institutions with good track records, both domestic and international, as well as candidates who already have work experience. This process is organized centrally and coordinated by the Human Capital Management Division. The recruitment process through the PTT Program is conducted through stages of administrative selection, psychological tests, health tests, and interviews.

2. Outsourcing

This is a program for hiring employees through a third party to fill supporting positions.

# PEKERJA ANAK DAN KERJA PAKSA [OJK F.19]

WSBP menentang keras praktik pekerja anak dan kerja paksa karena merupakan bentuk nyata pelanggaran terhadap hak asasi manusia. WSBP menetapkan batas minimal usia pegawai dan jam kerja pegawai, yaitu 18 tahun. Sedangkan untuk jam kerja yang disepakati adalah 8 jam 1 hari dan 40 jam 1 minggu untuk 5 hari kerja dalam 1 minggu (Senin -Jumat), sesuai dengan pasal 77 Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia No. 13 Tahun 2003 tentang Ketenagakerjaan.

Secara khusus, WSBP memberlakukan sistem kerja bergiliran pada beberapa unit operasional dan level pegawai tertentu, yang pengaturannya disesuaikan dengan kondisi lapangan pekerjaan. Apabila terdapat kelebihan waktu kerja, hal itu akan diperhitungkan sebagai kerja lembur yang besaran kompensasinya telah ditetapkan WSBP sehingga tidak merugikan pegawai. WSBP juga memberikan kesempatan kepada pegawai untuk beristirahat pada jam-jam tertentu.

Pelaksanaan kebijakan batasan minimal yang jelas terhadap usia dan jam kerja pegawai merupakan implementasi undang-undang ketenagakerjaan dan beberapa regulasi yang lain, seperti Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia No. 20 Tahun 1999 tentang Pengesahan Konvensi ILO No. 138 mengenai Usia Minimum untuk Diperbolehkan Bekerja, dan Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia No. 1 Tahun 2000 tentang Pengesahan Konvensi ILO No. 182 mengenai Pelarangan dan Tindakan Segera Penghapusan Bentuk-Bentuk Pekerjaan Terburuk untuk Anak.

# CHILD LABOR AND FORCED LABOR [OJK F.19]

WSBP strongly opposes the practices of child labor and forced labor as they are clear violations of human rights. WSBP sets a minimum age limit for employees at 18 years old. The agreed working hours are 8 hours per day and 40 hours per week for a 5-day work week (Monday - Friday), in accordance with Article 77 of Law of the Republic of Indonesia No. 13 of 2003 concerning Manpower.

Specifically, WSBP implements a shift work system for certain operational units and employee levels, regulated according to field work conditions. If there is overtime, it is calculated as overtime work with compensation rates set by WSBP so as not to disadvantage employees. WSBP also provides opportunities for employees to rest during certain hours.

The implementation of clear minimum age and working hour policies is an application of labor laws and several other regulations, such as Law of the Republic of Indonesia No. 20 of 1999 concerning Ratification of ILO Convention No. 138 Concerning Minimum Age for Admission to Employment, and Law of the Republic of Indonesia No. 1 of 2000 concerning Ratification of ILO Convention No. 182 Concerning The Prohibition And Immediate Action for The Elimination of The Worst Forms of Child Labour.

## PROGRAM PELATIHAN

Perusahaan mendorong seluruh Insan WSBP untuk meningkatkan kompetensi agar mampu menjalankan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya. Program Pelatihan HCM dibagi menjadi 6 kategori yang dilaksanakan di dalam dan di luar WSBP yaitu:

1. Pelatihan Pra-Kerja

Sebelum memulai pekerjaannya, para Insan WSBP baru akan dibekali dengan pengetahuan umum mengenai WSBP, proses bisnis, cara kerja, perangkat organisasi, nilai-nilai dan norma kerja yang berlaku, serta isi dari PKB.

2. Pelatihan Umum Dasar

Pelatihan ini ditujukan untuk meningkatkan keterampilan dasar dan/atau teknik dasar Insan WSBP, sekaligus untuk membentuk sikap dan perilaku yang sesuai dengan budaya WSBP.

3. Pelatihan Fungsional & Manajerial

Pelatihan ini merupakan pelatihan fungsional & manajerial untuk meningkatkan kemampuan Insan WSBP dalam suatu bidang pekerjaan sesuai dengan jabatannya.

## TRAINING PROGRAM

The Company encourages all Insan WSBP to enhance their competencies to be capable of carrying out their duties and responsibilities. The HCM Training Program is divided into 6 categories conducted both internally and externally:

1. Pre-Employment Training

Before starting their work, new Insan WSBP are equipped with general knowledge about WSBP, business processes, working methods, organizational structure, applicable work values and norms, and the content of the Collective Labor Agreement.

2. Basic General Training

This training aims to improve the basic skills and/or basic techniques of Insan WSBP, as well as to shape attitudes and behaviors aligned with WSBP's culture.

3. Functional & Managerial Training

This is functional & managerial training to enhance the capabilities of Insan WSBP in a specific work area according to their position.

# PENILAIAN PEGAWAI DAN JENJANG KARIER [GRI 404-3]

Dalam rangka mendorong motivasi pegawai untuk terus Produktif, WSBP memberikan kesempatan yang setara bagi seluruh Insan WSBP untuk menempuh jenjang karier yang jelas dan berkelanjutan. Perusahaan menyediakan system pengembangan karier berbasis kompetensi dan kinerja, sehingga setiap Insan WSBP memiliki peluang untuk berkembang sesuai dengan potensi dan kontribusinya. Adapun proses pengembangan karier pegawai telah diatur dalam Prosedur Pemenuhan Tenaga Kerja (PWP-HC-01), Penilaian Kinerja Pegawai (PWP-HC-03), Promosi Pegawai (PWP-HC-11).

Dalam melakukan penilaian kinerja, WSBP menerapkan system penilaian kinerja pegawai yang transparan, obyektif, dan tanpa diskriminasi. Penilaian dilakukan kepada seluruh pegawai (100%) untuk mewujudkan keadilan, dukungan, serta menetapkan target pencapaian kepada seluruh pegawai. Penilaian dilakukan secara adil kepada semua pegawai berdasarkan prestasi kerja tanpa membedakan Jenis kelamin. [GRI 3-3]

The Company provides a competency and performance-based career development system, thus providing every Insan WSBP with the opportunity to develop according to their potential and contribution. The Insan WSBP career development process has been regulated in the Manpower Fulfillment Procedure (PWP-HC-01), Employee Performance Assessment (PWP-HC-03), Employee Promotion (PWP-HC-11).

In conducting performance assessments, WSBP applies a transparent, objective, and non-discriminatory employee performance assessment system. The assessment is conducted for all employees (100%) to ensure fairness, support, and the establishment of achievement targets for every employee. The appraisal is done in a fair manner to all employees based on their work performance, regardless of gender. [GRI 3-3]

Untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang aman, sehat, dan produktif, WSBP menerapkan Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (SMK3) berdasarkan Peraturan Pemerintah Nomor 50 Tahun 2012 tentang Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (SMK3). Melalui pengelolaan SMK3 yang terstruktur, Perusahaan memastikan bahwa setiap tahapan operasionalnya, mulai dari produksi hingga distribusi, dilaksanakan sesuai dengan standar keselamatan yang berlaku.

Implementasi SMK3 diyakini tidak hanya melindungi Insan WSBP dari risiko kecelakaan kerja, tetapi juga meningkatkan efisiensi operasional dan memperkuat kepercayaan pemangku kepentingan terhadap komitmen Perusahaan dalam menjalankan operasinya secara bertanggung jawab dan berkelanjutan. 3. Menciptakan tempat kerja yang aman, nyaman, dan efisien untuk mendorong produktivitas.

# OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (OHSMS) [GRI G4 CRE6]

To create a safe, healthy, and productive workplace, WSBP implements the Occupational Health and Safety Management System (OHSMS) based on the Government Regulation No. 50 of 2012 concerning Occupational Health and Safety Management System (OHSMS). Through structured OHSMS management, the Company ensures that each of its operational stages, from production to distribution, is carried out in accordance with applicable safety standards.

The implementation of OHSMS is believed to not only protect Insan WSBP from the risks of work accidents but also enhances operational efficiency and strengthen stakeholders' trust in the Company's commitment to conducting its operations responsibly and sustainably. OHSMS is applied within WSBP, hence all Insan WSBP are covered by this system. [GRI 403-1, 403-8]

# The objectives of WSBP OHSMS are:

1. To improve the effectiveness of occupational health and safety protection, which is planned, measurable, structured, and integrated;
2. To prevent and reduce work accidents and occupational related-diseases by involving the elements of management, employees/workers, and/or trade union/ labor union; as well as
3. To create a safe, comfortable, and efficient workplace so as to boost productivity.

# PROGRAM PENINGKATAN KESELAMATAN KERJA

Mengacu pada Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia Republik Indonesia No. 1 Tahun 1970 tentang Keselamatan Kerja, WSBP memprioritaskan keselamatan kerja dalam kegiatan operasionalnya. Untuk mewujudkan dan mengoptimalkan praktik keselamatan, WSBP melengkapi Kantor Pusat dan Area Operasional dengan berbagai sarana dan sarana kelengkapan kerja, serta mengecek fungsi sarana dan prasarana tersebut secara berkala. Perusahaan juga secara berkala melakukan pengecekan dan pemeliharaan dalam jangka waktu tertentu. Gantry Crane dan Crawler Crane misalnya, Perusahaan rutin melakukan preventive maintenance setiap 250 jam agar kualitas alat-alat yang digunakan tetap terjaga dan aman untuk dioperasikan.

Penguatan praktik keselamatan kerja juga dilakukan dengan menyiapkan sarana dan prasarana keselamatan kerja antara lain Alat Pelindung Diri (APD), Kotak Pertolongan Pertama pada Kecelakaan (P3K), emergency box, Alat Pemadam Api Ringan (APAR), dan sebagainya. Selain penyediaan sarana dan prasarana, WSBP secara berkala juga melakukan simulasi menghadapi kondisi atau kegawatan tertentu, seperti adalah tanggap gawat darurat kebakaran, gempa bumi dan tumpahan B3. [GRI 403-5]

# PROGRAM PENINGKATAN KESEHATAN KERJA

Sebagai bentuk kepatuhan terhadap Pasal 100, Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia No. 17 Tahun 2023 tentang Kesehatan, WSBP memberikan perhatian terhadap peningkatan kesehatan kerja. WSBP berupaya menjamin kesehatan Insan WSBP melalui berbagai kegiatan diantaranya menyediakan pemeriksaan kesehatan (medical check up) secara berkala untuk Insan WSBP. Program ini dilakukan sebagai sebagai upaya preventif/mencegah terjadinya penyakit akibat kerja. Selain itu, Perusahaan juga memberikan perlindungan kerja dengan mengikutsertakan seluruh Insan WSBP dalam BPJS Kesehatan dan asuransi jiwa yang ditunjuk dengan nilai pertanggungan yang ditetapkan Perusahaan.

# OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM

Referring to the Law of the Republic of Indonesia No. 1 of 1970 concerning Occupational Safety, WSBP prioritizes work safety in its operations. To support and optimize the realization of work safety, WBSP equips its Head Office and Operational Unit with a variety of work facilities and equipment, and checks the function of these facilities and infrastructure periodically. For several work facilities and infrastructure, WSBP carries out checks and maintenance within a certain period. For example, Gantry Crane and Crawler Crane, the Company routinely carries out preventive maintenance every 250 hours so that the quality of the equipment used is maintained and safe to operate.

The reinforcement of work safety is also realized through the provision of safety facilities and infrastructure, including Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), First Aid box for Accidents (P3K), emergency box, Light Fire Extinguishers (APAR), and other necessary safety equipment. Apart from providing facilities and infrastructure, WSBP also periodically carries out simulations to deal with certain conditions or emergencies, such as emergency response to fires, earthquakes, and hazardous spills. [GRI 403-5]

# OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM

As part of its compliance with Article 100 of Law of the Republic of Indonesia No. 17 of 2023 concerning Health, WSBP prioritizes the improvement of occupational health. WSBP strives to ensure the health of Insan WSBP through various activities, including providing regular medical check-ups for Insan WSBP. This program serves as a prevention of work-related illnesses. Additionally, the Company also provides employment protection by enrolling all Insan WSBP in the designated BPJS Kesehatan (National Health Insurance) and life insurance programs, with coverage values determined by the Company.

Sustainable Corporate Governance

WSBP memastikan setiap konsumen dapat memperoleh akses informasi, kualitas produk, dan standar layanan yang sama. WSBP juga menerapkan prosedur dan standar layanan yang terstruktur, sehingga setiap konsumen diperlakukan secara konsisten dan dapat dipertanggungjawabkan. Hal ini menciptakan kepastian, mengurangi potensi konflik, serta memperkuat kepercayaan konsumen terhadap Perusahaan.

Untuk mengetahui tanggapan konsumen terhadap produk dan layanan Perusahaan, WSBP menyediakan mekanisme komunikasi dan pengaduan yang dapat diakses oleh seluruh pelanggan. Setiap keluhan yang masuk akan ditindaklanjuti secara profesional, transparan, dan tepat waktu, sebagai bentuk tanggung jawab perusahaan terhadap kepuasan dan hak pelanggan. Dengan memberikan layanan yang setara, WSBP membangun hubungan bisnis yang sehat, berkelanjutan, dan saling menguntungkan, sekaligus memperkuat reputasi Perusahaan sebagai mitra strategis yang dapat dipercaya.

WSBP ensures that every consumer may obtain access to the same information, product quality, and service standards. WSBP also implements structured service procedures and standards, ensuring that every customer is treated consistently and responsibly. This creates certainty, reduces the potential for conflict, and strengthens customer trust in the Company.

To determine consumer feedback on the Company's products and services, WSBP provides a communication and complaint mechanism accessible to all customers. Every complaint received will be followed up professionally, transparently, and on time, as a form of the company's responsibility to customer satisfaction and rights. By providing equal service, WSBP builds healthy, sustainable, and mutually beneficial business relationships while strengthening the Company's reputation as a trustworthy strategic partner.

# PELABELAN DAN INFORMASI PRODUK DAN JASA [GRI 2-7, 417-1, 417-2]

Dalam rangka menjaga kepercayaan konsumen, sekaligus wujud nyata komitmen Perusahaan terhadap transparansi dan keamanan produk, WSBP memastikan setiap produk yang dihasilkan telah dilengkapi dengan informasi yang jelas, lengkap, dan mudah dipahami. [GRI 3-3] Informasi tersebut bertujuan agar konsumen dapat mengetahui spesifikasi teknis, kegunaan dan penggunaan atau proses pemasangan/instalasi produk secara aman sesuai buku manual, serta memahami komponen dari setiap produk.

# PRODUCT AND SERVICE LABELING AND INFORMATION [GRI 2-7, 417-1, 417-2]

To maintain consumer trust, as well as a concrete manifestation of the Company's commitment to transparency and product safety, WSBP ensures that each product being produced is equipped with clear, complete, and easy-to-understand information. [GRI 3-3] This information aims to enable consumers to understand the technical specifications, purpose, and usage, or the safe installation/assembly process of the products in accordance with the product manual, as well as to comprehend the components of each product.

Beberapa informasi yang terdapat pada produk Beton Precast meliputi Logo, Tipe Produksi, Tanggal Produksi, dan Nomor Produksi. Pada Beton Readymix, produk tidak memiliki logo yang tertampil pada produk, namun terdapat logo pada Truck Mixer untuk pengiriman produk Beton Readymix. Selain itu terdapat Nomor Truck Mixer pada pintu luar bagian pengemudi dan penumpang untuk mengetahui produk yang dikirim sesuai dengan surat jalan. Sedangkan informasi yang terdapat pada lokasi proyek yang menggunakan Jasa Konstruksi WSBP adalah office panel atau pagar lokasi yang menggunakan logo WSBP dan plang K3. Seluruh informasi ini nantinya akan dilepas pada saat proyek selesai dikerjakan.

Some of the information found on Precast Concrete products includes the Logo, Production Type, Production Date, and Production Number. For Readymix Concrete, no logo is displayed directly on the product itself; however, a logo is present on the Truck Mixer used for the delivery of Readymix Concrete products. In addition, the Truck Mixer Number is displayed on the outer driver's and passenger's side door to verify that the delivered product corresponds to the delivery order. Meanwhile, information found at project sites utilizing WSBP's Construction Services includes an office panel or site fence bearing the WSBP logo and an Occupational Health and Safety (K3) signboard. All such information will be removed upon the completion of the project.

# TJSL DAN TUJUAN PEMBANGUNAN BERKELANJUTAN [OJK F.25]

WSBP melaksanakan program Tanggung Jawab Sosial dan Lingkungan (TJSL) sebagai wujud komitmen Perusahaan dalam mendukung pembangunan berkelanjutan di Indonesia. Program TJSL tersebut mencakup berbagai bidang, antara lain sosial kemasyarakatan, pendidikan, kesehatan, lingkungan, serta seni dan budaya. Sebelum pelaksanaan program, Perusahaan terlebih dahulu melakukan pemetaan sosial dan uji tuntas guna mengidentifikasi kebutuhan masyarakat serta potensi wilayah sasaran. Melalui pendekatan partisipatif, WSBP melibatkan masyarakat dalam proses perencanaan hingga implementasi program, sehingga mampu menumbuhkan rasa memiliki sekaligus memastikan keberlanjutan manfaat yang dihasilkan.

Sebagai perusahaan publik, pelaksanaan TJSL oleh WSBP juga merupakan bentuk kepatuhan terhadap Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) No. 51/POJK.03/2017 tentang Penerapan Keuangan Berkelanjutan bagi Lembaga Jasa Keuangan, Emiten, dan Perusahaan Publik yang efektif berlaku sejak 1 Januari 2021. Mengacu pada Pasal 8 peraturan tersebut, perusahaan publik yang melaksanakan TJSL dapat mengalokasikan sebagian dananya untuk mendukung penerapan keuangan berkelanjutan. Dalam konteks ini, keuangan berkelanjutan dimaknai sebagai kegiatan usaha yang mengintegrasikan aspek ekonomi, lingkungan, dan sosial secara berimbang dalam operasional perusahaan guna menciptakan nilai jangka panjang bagi seluruh pemangku kepentingan.

Di WSBP, pelaksanaan TJSL dilakukan melalui Program Tanggung Jawab Sosial Perusahaan TJSL dengan berpedoman pada Keputusan Direksi No. 232/SK/WBP/PEN/2024 tanggal 20 Desember 2024 tentang Prosedur Tanggung Jawab Sosial & Lingkungan. Pelaksanaan TJSL sekaligus merupakan kepatuhan Perusahaan terhadap Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia No. 25 Tahun 2007 tentang Penanaman Modal, Pasal 15 huruf b, yang menegaskan bahwa setiap penanam modal berkewajiban melaksanakan Tanggung Jawab Sosial Perusahaan (TJSL). Dalam implementasi di lapangan, TJSL di WSBP juga berpedoman pada standar internasional ISO 26000 yang telah diadopsi menjadi SNI ISO 26000.

# CSR AND SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT GOALS [OJK F.25]

WSBP implements Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) programs as a manifestation of the Company's commitment to supporting sustainable development in Indonesia. These CSR programs cover various fields, including social welfare, education, health, the environment, as well as arts and culture. Prior to program implementation, the Company first conducts social mapping and due diligence to identify community needs and the potential of the target areas. Through a participatory approach, WSBP involves the community in the planning and implementation processes, thereby fostering a sense of ownership while ensuring the sustainability of the benefits generated.

As a public company, WSBP's implementation of CSR also constitutes compliance with Financial Services Authority (OJK) Regulation No. 51/POJK.03/2017 on the Application of Sustainable Finance for Financial Services Institutions, Issuers, and Public Companies, which took effect on January 1, 2021. Pursuant to Article 8 of the regulation, public companies implementing CSR may allocate a portion of their funds to support the implementation of sustainable finance. In this context, sustainable finance is defined as business activities that integrate economic, environmental, and social aspects in a balanced manner within company operations to create long-term value for all stakeholders.

At WSBP, the implementation of CSR is carried out through the Corporate Social Responsibility Program, guided by Board of Directors Decision No. 232/SK/WBP/PEN/2024 dated December 20, 2024, regarding Procedures for Social and Environmental Responsibility's implementation of CSR also constitutes the Company's compliance with Law of the Republic of Indonesia No. 25 of 2007 on Investment, Article 15(b), which stipulates that every investor is obligated to implement Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). In its field implementation, WSBP's CSR also adheres to the international standard ISO 26000, which has been adopted as SNI ISO 26000.

# Persyaratan Kualitas Bahan Baku Utama

Perusahaan menerapkan prinsip kehat-hatian dan pengendalian mutu yang tinggi dalam memilih dan menyediakan bahan baku. Upaya ini dilakukan untuk menjamin kualitas produksi yang dihasilkan sesuai dengan standard yang berlaku sehingga bisa memenuhi harapan konsumen/pelanggan. Beberapa persyaratan kualitas bahan baku utama yang diterapkan oleh Perusahaan antara lain:

1. Semen

Jenis semen yang digunakan sebagai bahan baku pembuatan beton disesuaikan dengan karakteristik dari tipe beton dengan kualitas semen yang distandardisasi di Indonesia.

2. Air

Persyaratan penggunaan air untuk proses produksi beton harus memenuhi Persyaratan Umum Bahan Bangunan di Indonesia, antara lain:

a. Air harus bersih;
b. Tidak mengandung lumpur, minyak, dan benda terapung lainnya yang dapat dilihat secara visual;

The Company endeavors to establish cooperation with suppliers or third parties to procure production raw materials. Supplier or third-party partners must meet specific requirements, including that the managed location/land complies with environmental impact analysis regulations and holds an Production Business License (IUP).

In addition to collaborating with third parties, WSBP meets its raw material needs through its own quarries located in Bojonegara, Cilegon, Banten Province, and Lumbang, East Java. The procurement of goods and services at WSBP refers to the latest policy dated January 28, 2022, as stipulated in the President Director's Decree No. 03.ISO9001.2022.01 concerning the Procurement Policy of PT Waskita Beton Precast Tbk. This policy includes provisions that prioritize the use of domestically produced goods, national design and engineering, and the expansion of opportunities for small enterprises, provided that quality, price, and purpose can be justified.

The Company applies the principles of prudence and strict quality control in selecting and providing raw materials. This effort is undertaken to guarantee that the quality of the produced output complies with applicable standards, thereby meeting customer expectations. The type of cement used as a raw material for concrete production is adjusted to the characteristics of the concrete type, with cement quality standardized in Indonesia.

a. Water must be clean;
b. It must not contain mud, oil, or other floating objects visible to the naked eye;

# 3. Pasir (Agregat Halus)

# 3. Sand (Fine Aggregate)

Sand material for the Company's Precast Concrete and Readymix Concrete production needs is sourced from several regions, namely Tayan, Tanjung Lubuk, Lumajang, Galunggung and Cimalaka. Fine aggregate is aggregate with a particle size smaller than 4.75 mm (ASTM C 125 - 06). Requirements regarding the proportion of aggregate with the recommended ideal gradation are contained in the ASTM C33/33M Standard "Standard Specification for Concrete Aggregates."

d. Tidak boleh mengandung lumpur lebih dari 1%, jika melebihi harus dicuci.

# 4. Coarse Aggregate (Split)

According to ASTM C 33/03 and ASTM C 125 - 06, coarse aggregate (gravel, crushed stone, or blast furnace slag) is aggregate with a particle size larger than 4.75 mm. Provisions regarding coarse aggregate include:

a. It must consist of hard, non-porous particles.
b. The coarse aggregate particles must be durable, meaning they do not break down or disintegrate due to weather influences, such as intense sun and rain;
c. It must not contain substances that can damage concrete; and
d. It must not contain more than 1% silt; if it exceeds this limit, it must be washed.

5. Bahan Aditif (Admixture)

Admixture atau bahan tambahan adalah material selain air, agregat, dan semen hidrolik yang dicampurkan dalam beton atau mortar yang ditambahkan sebelum atau selama pengadukan berlangsung. Bahan tambah yang digunakan untuk memodifikasi sifat dan karakteristik dari beton bertujuan untuk mempermudah pengerjaan, mempercepat pengerasan, menambah kuat tekanan, atau penghematan energi. Beberapa jenis bahan aditif yang digunakan antara lain:

a. Air-entraining Admixture yang digunakan untuk meningkatkan ketahanan beton terhadap efek beku dan cair serta memperbaiki ketahanan terhadap kerusakan yang diakibatkan oleh garam.
b. Accelerating Admixture yang digunakan untuk mempercepat waktu ikat dan perkembangan kekuatan awal (early strength).
c. Retarding Admixture yang digunakan untuk memperlambat pengerasan beton dan menghambat kenaikan temperatur.
d. Superplasticizer yang digunakan untuk mengurangi kandungan air di dalam beton dan meningkatkan nilai slump dari beton.
e. Waterproofing material yang digunakan untuk memperlambat penetrasi air ke dalam beton yang berpori.

5. Admixtures (Additives)

Admixtures or additives are materials other than water, aggregate, and hydraulic cement that are mixed into concrete or mortar, added before or during the mixing process. These additives are used to modify the properties and characteristics of concrete, aiming to improve workability, accelerate setting, increase compressive strength, or save energy. Several types of admixtures used include:

a. Air-entraining Admixtures: Used to increase concrete's resistance to freeze-thaw effects and improve its durability against damage caused by salts.
b. Accelerating Admixtures: Used to accelerate the setting time and the development of early strength.
c. Retarding Admixtures: Used to delay the hardening of concrete and inhibit temperature rise.
d. Superplasticizers: Used to reduce the water content in concrete and increase its slump value.
e. Waterproofing Materials: Used to slow down the penetration of water into porous concrete.

Dalam menghitung intensitas emisi, Perusahaan menggunakan rumus sebagai berikut:

In calculating emission intensity, the Company uses the following formula:

$$
\text{Intensitas Emisi} = \frac{\text{Total Emisi (CO2eq)}}{\text{Total Emission (CO2eq)}}
$$

$$
= \frac{\text{Jumlah Produksi (M3)}}{\text{Production Quantity (M3)}}
$$

Berdasarkan acuan rumus tersebut, intensitas emisi tahun 2025 sebesar  $14.59\mathrm{kgCO}_{2}\mathrm{eg} / \mathrm{m}^{3}$ , mengalami kenaikan dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya yang mencapai  $10.99\mathrm{kgCO}_{2}\mathrm{eg} / \mathrm{m}^{3}$ . Penghitungan intensitas emisi tidak memasukkan emisi Cakupan 3 karena perjalanan dinas dengan pesawatanya dilakukan oleh personel yang terbatas, yaitu Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi. Pengelolaan emisi yang dilakukan WSBP tidak hanya dilakukan dengan membangun budaya efisiensi energi, tetapi juga memperhatikan penggunaan Bahan Perusak Ozon (BPO), yaitu senyawa kimia yang potensial dapat bereaksi dengan molekul ozon di lapisan stratosfer. Senyawa BPO biasa digunakan untuk mesin pendingin ruangan (AC), kulkas, dan tabung pemadam api.

The emissions management carried out by WSBP is not only done by building a culture of energy efficiency but also by paying attention to the use of Ozone-Depleting Substances (ODS), which are chemical compounds that can potentially react with ozone molecules in the stratospheric layer. ODS compounds are commonly used in air conditioning units (AC), refrigerators, and fire extinguishers.

Menyadari dampak buruk dari penggunaan BPO yang dapat merusak lapisan ozon, WSBP mendukung pelarangan penggunaan zat tersebut dengan memastikan teknologi yang digunakan Perusahaan tidak menggunakan senyawa kimia BPO. Atas dasar itu, Perusahaan menggunakan refrigerant AC yang ramah lingkungan berupa freon R32. [OJK F.12] [GRI 3-3, 305-6, G4CR4]

Aware of the adverse impacts of ODS use which can damage the ozone layer, WSBP supports the ban on the use of these substances by ensuring the technology employed by the Company does not use ODS chemicals. Based on this, the Company uses environmentally friendly AC refrigerant in the form of R32 freon. [OJK F.12] [GRI 3-3, 305-6]

# Pengelolaan Air dan Air Limbah

Kebutuhan akses dan ketersediaan air bersih hingga kini masih terbatas di berbagai wilayah, sehingga menjadi tantangan serius bagi kualitas hidup masyarakat. Keterbatasan ini dapat disebabkan oleh kerusakan lingkungan, pencemaran sumber air, serta infrastruktur penyediaan air yang belum memadai. Menyikapi hal itu, Perusahaan berkomitmen untuk berkontribusi mewujudkan Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (TPB) ke-6, menyatakan, "Memastikan ketersediaan dan pengelolaan air dan sanitasi yang berkelanjutan untuk semua orang." WSBP melakukan pengelolaan air secara terukur dan bertanggung jawab agar tidak berdampak negatif terhadap lingkungan dan masyarakat, khususnya yang berada di sekitar Perusahaan beroperasi. [GRI 3-3, 303-1]

Kebutuhan air di Perusahaan terbagi untuk kegiatan produksi dan domestik. Pada proses produksi, Perusahaan menggunakan air yang harus memenuhi persyaratan tertentu, seperti tidak boleh mengandung benda-benda tersuspensi lebih dari 2 gram per liter. Selain itu, air juga digunakan untuk menyiram tanaman, mencuci peralatan produksi, dan sebagainya.

Seiring dengan semakin terbatasnya ketersediaan air bersih, WSBP melakukan berbagai langkah efisiensi dalam penggunaan air secara bijaksana. Perusahaan dengan secara rutin mengecek instalasi air sehingga bisa dilakukan perbaikan apabila terjadi kerusakan atau kebocoran. Efisiensi penggunaan air sejalan dengan Peraturan Pemerintah Republik Indonesia No. 82 Tahun 2001 tentang Pengelolaan Kualitas Air dan Pengendalian

# Water and Wastewater Management

Access to and the availability of clean water remain limited in various regions to this day, posing a serious challenge to community quality of life. These limitations can be caused by environmental damage, water source pollution, and inadequate water supply infrastructure. In response to this, the Company is committed to contributing to the achievement of Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 6, which states, "Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all." WSBP manages water in a measured and responsible manner to avoid negative impacts on the environment and communities, especially those around the Company's operational areas. [GRI 3-3, 303-1]

The Company's water needs are divided between production and domestic activities. In the production process, the Company uses water that must meet specific requirements, such as containing no more than 2 grams per liter of suspended solids. Additionally, water is used for watering plants, washing production equipment, and so forth.

In line with the increasingly limited availability of clean water, WSBP implements various water efficiency measures for prudent water use. The Company routinely checks water installations so repairs can be made in case of damage or leaks. The Company also implements water efficiency measures by treating wastewater generated from the precast and ready-mix concrete production processes. The treated water is then reused for activities such as spraying split stone raw materials.

Regarding wastewater quality standards, the Company refers to Regulation of the Minister of Environment and Forestry of the Republic of Indonesia No. 5 of 2014 on Wastewater Quality Standards as well as relevant local regulations governing Wastewater Quality Standards. The characteristic of wastewater from concrete production typically has a high pH value due to the presence of alkaline chemicals caused by the use of cement, which contains limestone.

The 2025 test results show that the average pH level of wastewater from WSBP's production process is 9.00, which remains within the applicable standard pH range of 6-9. With this quality, no water bodies are affected or negatively impacted by the wastewater discharged by the Company. Meanwhile, the volume of wastewater discharged into water bodies was recorded at 8,614.69 m³ or equivalent to 8.62 megaliters, representing an decrease compared to 2024, which reached 12,739 m³. [GRI 303-2, 303-4]

The process of treating wastewater into clean water conducted by the Company is as follows: [GRI 303-2]

1. Before wastewater enters the pre-treatment tank, the wastewater drainage has a screen to separate any carried waste.
2. The wastewater flows into the pre-treatment tank to homogenize the wastewater.
3. From the pre-treatment tank, the wastewater enters the sedimentation tank for natural settling.
4. The wastewater from sedimentation flows into the neutralization tank where chemicals (acid) are added to lower the pH value, as the wastewater before treatment tends to be alkaline or >9.
